title: Short-Form Video Editor | Social Media Content | Long-Term Opportunity
description:
Location: Remote – Philippines

Compensation: $400–$600 USD/month (based on experience and availability)

Position: Long-Term Opportunity



About Us



We’re a growing US-based media and marketing company looking for a talented, creative, and reliable video editor to join our team!



We create content for multiple brands across estate sales, home cleanouts, entrepreneurship, podcasts, music, and personal brands.



Our videos are primarily published on Instagram, TikTok,
, and YouTube.



We already have an established production team and are looking for another editor to help us increase our content output while maintaining quality.



We’re not looking for someone who simply cuts clips together. We want someone who understands storytelling, pacing, and what makes people stop scrolling.



What You’ll Be Editing



You’ll work on a variety of projects, including:



* Short-Form Videos: Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and
 Reels.

* Interviews: Customer interviews, team interviews, and talking-head content.

* Business Content: Estate sale previews, home cleanout transformations, before-and-after videos, and promotional reels.

* Podcasts: Engaging clips and highlights from longer conversations.

* Music & Entertainment: Artist promotions, performance clips, and behind-the-scenes content.



Most videos range from 15 seconds to 2 minutes, with occasional longer projects.



Responsibilities



* Edit engaging videos from raw footage.

* Identify strong hooks and select the best clips.

* Add captions, B-roll, music, sound effects, and transitions where appropriate.

* Create videos with strong pacing and storytelling.

* Follow creative briefs and maintain consistent styles across brands.

* Meet deadlines and complete revisions efficiently.

* Communicate proactively with our team.

* Keep project files organized and properly submitted.



Our Workflow & Communication



We have an established production system that every team member is expected to follow.



ClickUp – Task Management



* All editing assignments, deadlines, and instructions are managed in ClickUp.

* Editors must keep task statuses updated and submit completed work for review.



Slack – Daily Communication



* Slack is our primary team communication platform.

* Editors are expected to communicate regularly during their scheduled working hours.

* A brief daily update is required covering completed work, current projects, and any questions or roadblocks.

* If a deadline may be missed, we expect proactive communication.



Dropbox – File Management



* All raw footage, project assets, and finished videos are stored in Dropbox.

* Editors must follow our folder structure and naming conventions.

* Completed videos and relevant project files must be uploaded to the correct folders.



Organization, accountability, and communication are just as important to us as editing ability.



Requirements



* Proven experience editing short-form social media videos.

* Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut Desktop, or similar software.

* Strong understanding of storytelling, hooks, and audience retention.

* Experience with captions, B-roll, music selection, and audio editing.

* Good written English communication skills.

* Reliable internet connection and capable editing computer.

* Ability to work independently, follow instructions, and meet deadlines.

* Willingness to learn and consistently use ClickUp, Slack, and Dropbox.



Bonus Skills:



* Podcast and long-form YouTube editing.

* Motion graphics or After Effects.

* Color grading and audio enhancement.

* Experience editing for US-based businesses.

* Ability to suggest creative content ideas from existing footage.



Editing Style & Expectations



Our content should feel authentic, engaging, and entertaining.



We value clean editing, natural pacing, strong storytelling, and creative decisions that improve the video.



We don’t want unnecessary effects or excessive transitions.



Some videos require polished, detailed editing, while others are simple interviews or promotional clips. Understanding that difference and working efficiently is important.



For straightforward short-form videos, we generally expect a 24–48 hour turnaround, depending on the project.



We value editors who take initiative, communicate clearly, and consistently deliver quality work.



Compensation & Growth



Starting compensation: $400–$600 USD per month.



Final compensation and expected weekly workload will be discussed based on experience, availability, and editing ability.



We’re looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship.



As our company and content production grow, there will be opportunities for increased compensation and additional responsibilities.



Hiring Process



1. Application Review: We’ll review your experience, portfolio, and answers.

2. Interview: Selected candidates will be invited to a short video interview.

3. Paid Editing Test: Finalists will complete a small paid editing assignment using our footage.

4. 30-Day Trial: The selected candidate will begin with a paid trial period.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions in your application:



1. What is your name, and where are you located?

2. How many years of video editing experience do you have?

3. Please share links to at least 3 short-form videos you’ve personally edited.

4. What editing software do you use?

5. How many hours per week are you available?

6. What monthly compensation would you expect within our $400–$600 budget?

7. How long would it typically take you to edit a 60-second interview with captions, B-roll, and background music?

8. Have you used ClickUp, Slack, or Dropbox before?

9. Are you currently working with other clients or employers?

10. What types of videos do you enjoy editing most?



IMPORTANT – APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS



We want to work with people who pay attention to details and carefully follow instructions.

Start your application with:

title: Call a list of businesses for my laundromat
description:
# Part-time Outbound Caller: local business calls for a Jacksonville, FL laundromat (Tuesday to Thursday, 9 AM to noon US Eastern)



## About us



LaundroLab Jacksonville is a locally owned laundromat on Normandy Blvd in Jacksonville, Florida. Besides self-serve laundry, we pick up laundry from local businesses, wash, dry and fold it, and bring it back within 48 hours. A business's first order is free. We're a small local team, and we want our calls to sound like one local business talking to another, not a call center.



## What you'll do



- Call local businesses from a call list in Google Sheets, working top to bottom. They include gyms and martial arts studios, auto detailers, cleaning companies, spas and massage studios, daycares, pet groomers, small hotels and event venues. Many of them have already received an
 from us.

- Follow our call script and our notes on each type of business (provided). The goal of each call is to find the person who handles laundry and offer a free first order.

- When someone is interested, get their name, best phone number, what they need washed, roughly how much each week, and a good pickup day. Log it in the sheet and send Scott, one of the owners, a quick message the same day.

- When nobody answers, leave a short voi
.

- Log every call in the sheet: pick the outcome from the dropdown and add a one-line note.

- Watch our outreach inbox during your hours and reply quickly to businesses answering our
s, using a cheat sheet we provide. Fast replies matter.



A good day is about 30 to 35 calls, every one logged, plus quick replies to any
s that came in.



You'll introduce yourself by your first name as part of the LaundroLab team. You dial every call yourself, one at a time: no robocalls or autodialers. If anyone asks us not to contact them again, mark it in the sheet and we stop.



## Hours



Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, 9 AM to noon US Eastern Time. In the Philippines that's 10 PM to 1 AM from November to mid-March, and 9 PM to midnight the rest of the year. You'll report to Scott, with a check-in on Tuesday mornings to plan the week.



## What we're looking for



- Clear, friendly spoken English.

- Experience cold calling or setting appointments with US businesses.

- Clear, quick written English for
 replies.

- A quiet place to work, a reliable internet connection and a headset.

- Comfortable working in Google Sheets and Gmail.

- Nice to have: experience with local service businesses, or spoken Spanish.



## What we provide



The call list, our call script and notes for each type of business, an
 reply cheat sheet, access to our outreach inbox, and a training call before your first day.



## Pay



$5 to $6 per hour depending on experience, paid in US dollars every two weeks. On top of that, $10 for each business that places its first order from a lead you logged. This is a part-time contractor role, starting with a 60-day contract, with the chance to extend if it's working well.



## How to apply



Please send:

1. A voice recording of about 60 seconds, introducing yourself as if you were calling a gym owner about laundry pickup.

2. A few lines on your cold-calling experience and the kinds of businesses you've called.

3. Confirmation that you can work Tuesday to Thursday, 9 AM to noon US Eastern Time.



Please start your message with the word "Normandy" so we know you read the whole post.

title: Senior Video Editor (YouTube & High-Retention Content)
description:
Senior Video Editor (YouTube & High-Retention Content) 



We are a fast-growing digital media agency producing high-end YouTube long-form content, documentary-style videos, and viral short-form media for premium brands, creators, and organizations. 



We are looking for an exceptional, highly skilled Video Editor who understands that video editing is not just cutting clips—it is storytelling, pacing, viewer retention, and psychology.



If you are a master of visual pacing, sound design, motion graphics, and keeping viewers hooked from the first 3 seconds, this role is for you.



WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Long-Form YouTube Production: Edit high-retention YouTube videos (10–20+ mins) with tight pacing, strategic cuts, visual B-roll layering, and dynamic storytelling.

- Short-Form Repurposing: Extract and edit high-converting vertical Shorts/Reels/TikToks with kinetic typography, hooks, and punchy sound effects.

- Motion Graphics & Packaging: Build engaging lower thirds, on-screen text callouts, motion accents, graphics overlays, and custom visual transitions.

- Advanced Sound Design: Master audio levels, apply impactful sound effects (SFX), select music that drives emotion, and clean up voiceover audio.

- Color Grading: Perform clean, professional color correction and cinematic color grading.



REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVE):

1. Proven Skill & Track Record: Demonstrated hands-on editing skill with a proven portfolio showcasing high-retention YouTube long-form and short-form content.

2. Mastery of Software: Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Adobe After Effects (Final Cut Pro accepted if workflow/export speed is top-tier).

3. Advanced Sound Design: You treat audio as 50% of the video experience. You know how to layer sound FX to create depth and energy.

4. Strong Storytelling & Pacing: Ability to take raw A-roll and transform it into a tight, engaging narrative without fluff.

5. Hardware & Internet: High-spec editing computer (capable of smooth 4K editing and multi-layer rendering) + reliable high-speed internet (50+ Mbps with backup connection).

6. Fluent English Communication: Ability to understand creative directions, feedback, and script nuances easily.



WORK STRUCTURE:

- Position: Full-Time or High-Volume Project Retainer

- Growth: Performance reviews, performance bonuses, and career growth as lead editor.

- Work Style: 100% Remote (Work from home) with flexible hours.



HOW TO APPLY (IMPORTANT - FILTER INSTRUCTION):

To ensure you read the full job post, change the subject line of your message to:

"Master Editor Found - [Your Full Name]"



In your application, please include:

1. Your Portfolio Link: A link to your showreel, Google Drive, or YouTube portfolio showing your BEST 3 long-form YouTube edits and 2 short-form reels. (Submissions without a portfolio link will be ignored).

2. Your Primary Editing Suite: (e.g., Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve).

3. Your Gear Specs: Your CPU, GPU, RAM, and internet speed test screenshot.

4. Quick Question: What is the single most important factor for holding audience retention in the first 30 seconds of a YouTube video?



We are hiring immediately and reviewing portfolios as they come in. If your work stands out, we will reach out for a paid trial edit.

description:
About us

Coastal Pacific Dermatology is a busy independent dermatology and skin cancer surgery practice in Southern California. Our remote team in the Philippines already handles faxes, insurance, and operations, and we’re adding a new role: the voice and face of the practice for our patients.



The role

You’ll be our patients’ main point of contact, checking them out by video at the end of their visit and answering our phones. Warmth, clear communication, and fluent English matter more than anything else.



Important: this is a camera-on position. You’ll be live on video, visible to patients, for your entire shift. Please only apply if you’re comfortable being on camera all day.



Daily duties:



Join patients by video in the exam room at the end of their visit

Schedule follow-up appointments and procedures based on the provider’s instructions

Collect any remaining balances and help patients save a card on file

Answer questions about next steps and make sure patients leave knowing what comes next

Answer inbound patient calls (scheduling, rescheduling, general questions), especially on our busiest phone days, Mondays and Fridays

Later in training: greet arriving patients by video in our lobby and check them in



Schedule and pay



Full-time, during our clinic hours: 8-4 PM Pacific Time (overnight shift in Manila)

Starting at $9/hour

Long-term position with a stable, supportive team



Requirements



Fluent, near-native spoken English: clear, natural, unhurried, and warm. Patients should be able to understand you easily on video and over the phone.

Patience with elderly patients and people who aren’t comfortable with technology

Able to switch smoothly between video visits and phone calls

Comfortable on camera for a full shift

Professional appearance and a quiet, well-lit workspace with a neutral, uncluttered background (no virtual backgrounds)

Reliable high-speed internet and backup internet and backup power (please describe yours)

Computer with a good webcam and headset

Experience in US healthcare, medical reception, or a call center preferred

ModMed (EMA) experience is a strong plus

Understanding of patient privacy (HIPAA)



How to apply

Applications without a video will not be considered.



Use the subject line “Patient Welcome” so we know you read the full posting.

Record a short video (2–3 minutes) in your actual work setup:

Read this aloud: “Hi, I’m [your name], and I’ll be helping you check out today. Dr. Krishna would like to see you back in three months. I have a Tuesday morning in January available. Would that work for you?”

Then answer in your own words: “An elderly patient is confused about their next steps and getting frustrated. How would you help them?”

Briefly describe your backup internet and power setup, and any medical reception or call center experience.

title: Client Success & Lead Follow-Up Manager (High-Ticket Coaching)
description:
About PHNYX Group

PHNYX Group is a venture studio with operations in Dubai, Switzerland and China. We partner with founders to build, grow and sell physical product brands.



Our founder has built multiple brands, including PHNYX Watches, which has done millions in revenue. We also run high-ticket coaching programs and a mastermind that teach people how to build and grow ecommerce brands.



Why this role exists

Leads and clients are our most valuable relationships. Right now, follow-up depends on too many people remembering to do it.

We want one person who makes sure every lead is followed up, every client feels looked after, and every concern reaches our founder fast.



What you will own

Making sure every new lead is contacted within 5 minutes

Reading sales call notes in Fathom and keeping GHL up to date: who bought, who didn't, and why

Steady, helpful follow-up with everyone who hasn't bought yet

A weekly report on the main reasons people don't buy

Fast, smooth onboarding for new clients

Detailed client profiles: what they do, why they joined, where they live

Checking in with clients so they stay happy and keep growing with us

Flagging any client concern to our founder within 24 hours

Setting up follow-up automations in GHL and Zapier, or working with the person who does



What success looks like

No lead waits more than 5 minutes

60-70% of past clients buy again

Refunds at 1% or less, and fewer than 5% of clients cancel or quit in a year

Our founder always knows why people aren't buying

Clients feel genuinely cared for



Who we are looking for

Someone who genuinely cares about clients. You follow up because you want them to win, not just to close a sale.

You notice when a client goes quiet and reach out before they think about quitting. You hear the real reason behind "I need to think about it."

You are organized. No lead, note or promise ever falls through the cracks.



Experience required

You have worked in client success, sales operations or follow-up for a high-ticket coaching, education or consulting business

You have followed up with leads after sales calls and helped close them

You have onboarded and looked after high-ticket clients

You use GHL or a similar CRM every day

Big plus: offers priced $5,000+, mastermind experience, and building automations yourself



Technology you should know

GHL and Zapier

Fathom or a similar note-taker

DocuSign


, Loom, Google Workspace

ChatGPT and Claude



How we work

Full time and fully remote

5 days a week, split shift: 5 hours in Dubai working hours and 4 hours in US Eastern hours

Finish your week's tasks and Saturday is off. Our weekly team meeting is on Fridays.

You report to our Chief of Staff

You send a short Loom update every day

Reply times: under 2 hours is our standard, 24 hours is the absolute maximum



Compensation

$1,000-$1,200/month, depending on experience

Paid via PayPal or card payment (not bank transfer). Salary is paid at the end of each month for the first 4 months, then twice a month, on the 15th and the last day of the month

$2,000 quarterly bonus when refunds stay under 1%



2-week paid probation

You start with 2 paid weeks doing real work with our leads and clients. This is how we see what you can do, and how you see if you want to work with us.



If it goes well, you move to a month-to-month contract.



How to apply

Apply on OnlineJobs.ph with:

1. The subject line: "Client Success - [Your Name]" (we use this to check attention to detail)

2. The coaching or education businesses you've worked for, and your role

3. Proof of results: follow-up close rates, retention or refund numbers

4. A Loom video, 3 minutes max, introducing yourself and explaining how you follow up with a lead who said "I need to think about it"

5. Your answers to these application questions. Each question asks for specifics that are hard to fake. Vague answers score low:

>> Which coaching or education business did you work for? What were the offer prices, and what did YOU personally own?

>> What % of leads who didn't buy on the first call did you help close later? How did you track it?

>> A lead says "I need to talk to my spouse." Write the follow-up message you'd send the next day.

>> What are the 3 most common reasons people don't buy a high-ticket program? How do you handle each one?

>> Tell us about a client who wanted a refund. What did you do, and what happened?

>> How do you spot a client who is about to quit, before they say it?

>> What have you built in GHL or Zapier yourself? Be specific.

>> How do you make sure every lead is contacted within 5 minutes, even at night?

>> A lead asks for a 20% discount. Our limit is 7%. What do you say?

>> How do you turn a pile of sales call notes into something useful for the founder?

>> Describe a time you noticed a problem no one asked you to look at. What did you do?

>> Can you work 5 hours in Dubai working hours and 4 hours in US Eastern hours, 5 days a week? Yes or no.

title: Remote Outbound Caller – US Real Estate (Novation Agents)
description:
About Us

We are launching a new US platform that connects novation-friendly real estate agents with verified real estate investors. Investors post their deals directly on the platform, and agents log in and choose the deals that fit their market and business. No cold chasing, no middlemen, just real deals from verified investors, ready for an agent to list.



We are backed by an active US real estate investment company operating in about 10 states, and we are now building our agent network nationwide.



The Role

You will call US real estate agents who already work with novation deals (or are open to them), have a short professional conversation, ask a few qualifying questions, and introduce them to our platform. Your goal is to get them to sign up and understand how the platform works.



What You Will Do



Working Monday - Friday 9am est - 5pm est (include 1 hour break) 

Make outbound calls to real estate agents across the US from a lead list we provide

Ask qualifying questions, for example:

Have you worked on novation deals before? How many in the last 12 months?

Which areas or counties do you cover?

What price range and property types do you usually work with?

How do you currently get deals from investors?

Explain the platform simply: investors upload deals, agents choose the deals they want, everyone works with verified partners

Book agents for sign-up or a short follow-up call when needed

Log every call, answer, and outcome in our CRM

Report daily numbers (calls, conversations, sign-ups)



Must Have



Experience in US real estate: dispositions, acquisitions, cold calling for investors, or working with US agents

Understanding of how wholesaling and novation deals work (or strong real estate basics and fast learning)

Clear, neutral English with no strong accent. US agents must feel comfortable talking to you

Self-managed and reliable. We don't want to check on you all day. You know what needs to be done and you do it

Stable internet, quiet workspace, good headset

Available to work US business hours



Nice to Have



Experience with CRMs (GoHighLevel, Podio, or similar) and dialers

Experience talking with real estate agents specifically

Experience with a startup or new product launch



How to Apply

Send the following:



Your resume with your US real estate experience clearly listed

A 2-minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your US real estate experience

Your daily availability (in US Eastern Time)

Start your application with the words "Agent Network" so we know you read the full post



Applications without the voice recording will not be reviewed.

title: Ecommerce VA
description:
Ecommerce VA for a Fast-Growing DTC Beauty/Skincare Brand (2 Positions)



We are an 8-figure DTC skincare brand scaling aggressively on Meta, Google, and Amazon, with a creative team of 30+ people across leads, strategy, UGC, editing, media, design, and more. We are hiring two experienced Ecommerce Virtual Assistants who will work directly with the CEO, Director of Media, and Head of Creative. This is not an entry-level role. You will be the operational glue that keeps a large, fast-moving team organized, accountable, and hitting targets.



What you’ll do:



Operations and team coordination



-Own our Notion workspace: keep every task, board, and project up to date, correctly tagged, and moving through the pipeline with quick turnaround. We want Notion restructured and better organized, so real project management skill matters here

-Follow up with team members daily to confirm deliverables are on track and nothing stalls

-Track KPIs and bonus targets across departments, flag anyone falling behind, and report status to leadership

-Keep meeting notes, action items, and SOPs documented and organized

-Manage and add to our shared Google Drive of in-house docs and resources

-Asset management: keep raw footage, final exports, and brand assets organized in Drive and 
 with proper naming conventions so editors aren’t hunting for files, and make sure those conventions are followed across the whole team

Creative velocity tracking: how many net new ads shipped per week per strategist and editor



Customer trust and communications



-Manage Trustpilot: monitor reviews, respond professionally, invite happy customers to leave reviews, and escalate issues

Check in on the customer support team regularly and track their metrics

-Keep internal team communication clean and organized in Slack

-Hiring out team roles as needed



Ecommerce support



-Shopify admin tasks: order lookups, refunds, address edits, subscription adjustments, discount codes, basic product and page updates

-Monitor daily store health: orders, fulfillment status, failed payments, chargebacks, and subscription churn signals

-Prepare daily and weekly reports (sales, ad spend, ROAS, CS volume, review scores) pulled from our dashboards

-Coordinate with UGC creators, contractors, and vendors on deadlines, deliverables, and payments

-Light research tasks: competitor monitoring, sourcing creators or tools, pulling data when asked

Calendar management, inbox triage, and general executive assistant support for the CEO



Who we’re looking for



-Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience as an ecommerce VA for online DTC brands (this is a hard requirement)

Must have worked for at least one subscription-based ecommerce brand and be able to show proof (screenshots, references, or portfolio)

-Able to name the ecommerce brands you have worked for and describe exactly what you did for each

Strong hands-on experience with Shopify, Notion, Slack, 
, and Google Sheets. Experience with Trustpilot, Klaviyo, Re:amaze, and Loop is a big plus

-Extremely organized, detail-obsessed, and proactive. You notice problems before they become problems and you chase people down without being asked

-Must be proactive, driven, and hungry to succeed. We're looking for a true go-getter who takes ownership, executes without being micromanaged, and consistently finds ways to move projects forward.

-Brings thoughtful, educated ideas to the table rather than simply following instructions. You should be comfortable identifying opportunities for improvement, suggesting better processes, and helping the business operate more efficiently.

-Growth-minded and eager to develop alongside the company. We value people who want to take on more responsibility, make a meaningful impact, and grow into larger operational and leadership roles over time.

-Excellent written English and a professional, warm tone with customers

-Comfortable working closely with a CEO, giving direct updates, and being held to clear KPIs

-Available during US Eastern hours for overlap, with fast response times



Compensation

Competitive rate based on experience, with performance bonuses tied to team KPIs. Long-term role with room to grow into an operations lead position as the brand scales.



How to apply

To be considered, your application must include all of the following:



-The names of the ecommerce brands you’ve worked for and your role at each

-Proof of your experience with a subscription-based ecommerce brand

-A short paragraph on how you would keep a 30+ person team on track in Notion

-Why you applied for this role and why you are a team fit

-Where you would bring the most value to our team and why we should hire you

-Your top strengths as a VA



Applications missing any of the above will not be reviewed.

title: Local SEO Specialist Needed | Service-Based Company
description:
# Local SEO Specialist – HVAC Industry

**Location:** San Diego County, California, USA  

**Position Type:** Contract / Freelance / Full-Time (Open to Discussion)  

**Industry:** HVAC / Home Services  

**Experience Level:** Experienced / Senior-Level



## About Us



We are a growing HVAC company based in the suburbs of San Diego, California, serving residential and commercial customers throughout San Diego County and surrounding communities.



We are looking for a highly experienced, results-driven **Local SEO Specialist** to take full ownership of our local search engine optimization strategy, execution, and ongoing performance.



Our objective is simple: **Dominate local organic search results, improve our visibility in Google's Local Map Pack, outrank competing HVAC companies, and consistently generate qualified inbound leads through organic search.**



We are not looking for someone who simply understands SEO theory or provides generic recommendations. We need a hands-on specialist who can independently develop, implement, manage, and continuously optimize a comprehensive local SEO strategy.



**Applicants must have a proven track record of successfully improving local search rankings and generating measurable business results.**



## Key Responsibilities



### 1. Google Business Profile (GBP) Optimization

- Take full responsibility for optimizing and managing our Google Business Profile.

- Improve visibility and rankings within Google's Local Map Pack and Google Maps.

- Optimize business categories, services, descriptions, photographs, and other relevant profile attributes.

- Develop strategies to improve geographic visibility across our targeted San Diego communities.

- Implement legitimate customer review acquisition strategies and reputation management best practices.

- Monitor competitors and identify opportunities to improve our local search presence.

- Ensure compliance with Google's Business Profile guidelines.



### 2. Local SEO Strategy & Execution

- Develop and execute a comprehensive local SEO strategy targeting HVAC-related searches.

- Conduct extensive local keyword research for high-intent searches such as "AC repair near me," "HVAC installation San Diego," "furnace repair," and related services.

- Identify opportunities to rank in surrounding cities, suburbs, and neighborhoods throughout San Diego County.

- Develop and optimize individual service pages and geographically targeted landing pages with unique, valuable content.

- Perform competitive analysis of successful local HVAC companies.

- Implement local business schema markup and other relevant structured data.

- Maintain consistent business information across relevant directories and citations.



### 3. Website SEO & Technical Optimization

- Conduct a comprehensive technical SEO audit and implement necessary improvements.

- Optimize website architecture, internal linking, navigation, and URL structures.

- Improve page loading speeds, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals.

- Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, images, and on-page content.

- Identify and resolve crawling, indexing, canonicalization, redirect, and other technical SEO issues.

- Implement and manage Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, and appropriate conversion-tracking tools.

- Coordinate or directly implement website changes necessary to improve organic search performance.



### 4. Content Strategy & On-Page SEO

- Develop an SEO-focused content strategy designed to attract homeowners and businesses searching for HVAC services.

- Create or optimize service pages, location pages, blogs, FAQs, and educational content.

- Target high-converting keywords related to HVAC installation, maintenance, repairs, and emergency services.

- Ensure content is locally relevant, factually accurate, helpful, and optimized for search intent.

- Identify content gaps and opportunities based on competitor rankings and search demand.

- Optimize existing content to improve rankings, conversions, and lead generation.



### 5. Local Citations, Authority & Link Building

- Audit, correct, and maintain business citations across relevant online directories.

- Build high-quality, relevant backlinks through legitimate outreach and local partnerships.

- Identify opportunities to strengthen our website's authority within the HVAC and San Diego markets.

- Develop sustainable, white-hat off-page SEO strategies.

- Avoid spammy backlinks, paid review schemes, and tactics that could expose our business to search engine penalties.



### 6. Conversion Optimization & Lead Generation

- Focus on generating actual business opportunities, not simply increasing website traffic.

- Optimize website pages to improve calls, contact form submissions, and appointment requests.

- Implement call tracking and conversion attribution where appropriate.

- Analyze organic traffic behavior and recommend improvements to conversion rates.

- Continuously evaluate which keywords, services, and geographic areas generate the highest-quality leads.



### 7. Analytics, Reporting & Accountability

- Establish baseline performance metrics before implementing changes.

- Monitor local rankings, Google Business Profile performance, organic traffic, and qualified leads.

- Provide clear monthly performance reports outlining work completed, ranking improvements, traffic growth, and lead generation.

- Track performance for priority keywords across targeted San Diego communities.

- Communicate actionable recommendations and planned improvements.

- Take ownership of execution rather than simply providing audits or recommendations.



## Required Qualifications



- **Demonstrated success managing local SEO campaigns for service-based businesses.** HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, and other home-service industry experience is strongly preferred.

- Proven ability to improve Google Maps / Local Map Pack visibility and local organic rankings.

- Strong understanding of Google Business Profile optimization and local ranking factors.

- Advanced knowledge of technical SEO, on-page SEO, local content strategies, and legitimate link building.

- Experience using tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Ahrefs, Semrush, BrightLocal, Local Falcon, or similar platforms.

- Ability to independently execute SEO strategies with minimal supervision.

- Strong analytical skills and a demonstrated ability to translate SEO performance into measurable lead generation.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain strategies, progress, and results clearly.



## Mandatory: Proven Track Record & Portfolio



**We will only consider applicants who can demonstrate actual, verifiable results from previous local SEO projects.**



As part of the application process, candidates must provide:



1. **Real Case Studies:** At least 2–3 examples of local SEO campaigns personally managed, preferably for HVAC or other home-service businesses.

2. **Before-and-After Results:** Evidence of improvements in local search rankings, Google Maps visibility, organic traffic, or qualified lead generation.

3. **Actual Work Performed:** A detailed explanation of the specific strategies and changes you personally implemented to achieve those results.

4. **Measurable Business Impact:** Examples of increased inbound calls, appointment requests, form submissions, or other measurable business outcomes.

5. **References or Portfolio:** Links to previous projects, client references, or redacted reporting dashboards demonstrating your experience, where permitted by client confidentiality agreements.



**Generic agency presentations, theoretical SEO knowledge, and unverifiable ranking claims will not satisfy these requirements.**



We want to understand not only what results you achieved, but exactly **how you achieved them and what role you personally played in delivering those results.**



## What Success Looks Like



Our expectations for this position include:



- Consistent improvements in relevant local organic rankings.

- Increased visibility within Google's Local Map Pack across our priority service areas.

- Stronger organic search presence for high-intent HVAC keywords.

- Measurable increases in qualified inbound phone calls and service inquiries.

- Improved website performance and conversion rates.

- A sustainable, long-term SEO foundation that reduces our dependence on paid advertising over time.



We understand SEO is a long-term investment and do not expect overnight results. However, we expect clear execution, transparent reporting, measurable progress, and a well-defined roadmap.



## Ideal Candidate



Our ideal candidate is an experienced local SEO professional who has already helped home-service businesses compete successfully in crowded geographic markets.



You understand that ranking an HVAC company in a competitive Southern California market requires more than inserting keywords into a website. You know how to combine Google Business Profile optimization, technical SEO, local content, geographic targeting, authority building, and conversion optimization into a cohesive strategy.



Most importantly, you are comfortable being held accountable for measurable results and can demonstrate the quality of your work through past successes.



## How to Apply



Please submit your resume or professional profile along with the following:



- A brief overview of your local SEO experience, particularly within HVAC or home services.

- Links to 2–3 previous projects or detailed case studies.

- Before-and-after performance metrics demonstrating actual improvements.

- A summary of the specific SEO work you personally performed.

- Your proposed approach for improving the local search presence of a suburban San Diego HVAC company.

- Your compensation expectations and preferred working arrangement.



**Important:** Applications that do not include relevant case studies or documented examples of previous SEO results may not be considered.



We are looking to build a long-term relationship with an SEO specialist who can take ownership of our organic search presence and help establish our company as a leading HVAC provider throughout our target San Diego communities.

title: Lead Generation, Social Media & Location Acquisition Specialist (Canada)
description:
About Limemart



Limemart is a Canadian company expanding its network of AI-powered Smart Stores and micro markets across Southern Ontario.



We install self-service convenience stores and smart fridges in apartment buildings, condominiums, factories, offices, and other high-traffic locations. There is no upfront cost to the property, as Limemart handles installation, inventory, restocking, and maintenance.



We are looking for a results-driven Lead Generation & Location Acquisition Specialist who can identify potential locations, contact decision-makers, build relationships, and close new placement agreements.



This is not a basic virtual assistant or data-entry role. We need someone with strong outbound sales skills who can work independently and turn prospects into signed deals.



Responsibilities



- Research and build targeted lead lists of apartment buildings, condominiums, factories, offices, and other suitable properties in Southern Ontario, Canada.

- Identify decision-makers such as property managers, building owners, condominium management companies, facility managers, and HR managers.

- Contact prospects through phone calls,
, LinkedIn, and other appropriate channels.

- Explain Limemart’s Smart Store and micro market offering professionally.

- Follow up consistently, handle objections, and move prospects toward signed placement agreements.

- Qualify locations against our requirements and coordinate with the Limemart team to progress promising opportunities.

- Maintain accurate lead records and follow-up schedules using a CRM.

- Manage your pipeline independently and take initiative without constant supervision.



Ideal Location Requirements



Residential properties:

- At least 120 residential units, ideally with 150 or more residents.

- A suitable indoor common area with consistent foot traffic.

- Access to power and Wi-Fi.

- No existing micro market or convenience store inside the property or within approximately 250 meters.



Commercial and industrial properties:

- At least 100 employees per shift, ideally 150 or more.

- Preferably two or more shifts from Monday to Friday.

- A suitable breakroom or high-traffic area.

- Limited convenient food and snack options for employees.



Target regions include the Greater Toronto Area, Peel Region, Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, Guelph, and surrounding areas of Southern Ontario.



Compensation



- Fixed monthly salary: ₱20,000.

- Commission: ₱20,000 for every successful location closed.

- No commission cap.

- Additional earning potential based on your ability to close more locations.



Commission is earned when the location meets Limemart’s approval requirements, the placement agreement is signed, and the Smart Store or micro market is successfully installed.



Required Skills and Experience



- Experience in B2B sales, outbound sales, lead generation, appointment setting, or business development.

- Strong spoken and written English.

- Confidence speaking with business owners, property managers, and decision-makers.

- Ability to handle objections, follow up professionally, and close deals.

- Strong research, organization, and time-management skills.

- Ability to work independently and consistently meet targets.

- Reliable internet connection and a suitable environment for sales calls.



Preferred Qualifications



- Experience acquiring locations for vending machines, micro markets, smart fridges, or similar businesses.

- Experience working with Canadian or North American businesses.

- Familiarity with HubSpot or another CRM.

- Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and prospecting tools.

- A track record of closing B2B deals over the phone.



Application Requirements



Please submit the following with your application:



1. Your updated resume.

2. A one-minute recorded video introducing yourself and explaining why you are a good fit.

3. A brief summary of your relevant sales or location acquisition experience.

4. Your biggest sales achievement, including measurable results if possible.

5. The CRM and prospecting tools you have used.

6. Your salary expectations and confirmation that you are comfortable with the ₱20,000 monthly salary and ₱20,000 commission per successful location.



Interview Process



We are conducting invite-only, in-person interviews in Makati within the next two days. Shortlisted candidates will receive the interview schedule and venue details directly.



Please apply only if you can attend an in-person interview in Makati on short notice.



We are looking for someone proactive, persistent, commercially minded, and motivated by results. If you can turn cold prospects into signed location agreements, we want to hear from you.

title: Trustpilot Review & Online Reputation Specialist (Part-Time | Remote)
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and reliable **Trustpilot Review & Online Reputation Specialist** to join our team.



Your main responsibility is to monitor Trustpilot reviews across multiple e-commerce stores, respond to customer feedback, identify and report fake or suspicious reviews, and coordinate with our Customer Support team to resolve customer complaints.



We need someone who can work independently, take initiative, and actively help improve our stores' online reputation.



**Working Hours:** 2–3 hours per day  

**Job Type:** Part-Time | Remote  

**Schedule:** Flexible



### Key Responsibilities



- **Daily Review Monitoring:** Check all assigned Trustpilot accounts daily for new positive, neutral, and negative reviews.

- **Review Responses:** Respond professionally to customer reviews, especially negative reviews that require immediate attention.

- **Identify and Flag Fake Reviews:** Investigate suspicious, spam, misleading, or potentially fake reviews and report them through Trustpilot's official reporting system when they violate platform guidelines.

- **Review Verification:** Check available customer and order records to determine whether a review can be linked to a genuine customer experience.

- **Monitor Flagged Reviews:** Track reported reviews, follow up on Trustpilot's decisions, and document whether reviews are removed, retained, or under investigation.

- **Customer Follow-Ups:** Coordinate with the Customer Support team through Freshdesk to resolve complaints and follow up with customers when necessary.

- **Review Resolution:** Encourage customers to voluntarily update their reviews when their concerns have been resolved, without offering incentives or making assistance conditional on a review change.

- **Performance Tracking:** Maintain accurate records of reviews, customer responses, flagged reviews, resolutions, and changes in Trustpilot scores.

- **Weekly Reports:** Submit a weekly report summarizing review activity, TrustScores, complaint trends, flagged reviews, and completed tasks.

- **Continuous Improvement:** Identify recurring customer complaints and recommend actions to improve customer satisfaction and store reputation.



### Requirements



- Strong written English communication skills.

- Previous experience managing Trustpilot or other online review platforms is preferred.

- Familiarity with Freshdesk, Shopify, or similar customer service platforms is an advantage.

- Ability to identify suspicious reviews and understand Trustpilot's reporting guidelines.

- Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

- Ability to manage multiple stores and monitor review activity efficiently.

- Proactive attitude toward resolving complaints and following up on pending concerns.

- Ability to work independently and complete assigned tasks within limited working hours.

- Comfortable using Google Sheets for tracking and weekly reporting.



### What We're Looking For



We want someone who does more than simply reply to reviews. You should actively identify potential issues, investigate suspicious reviews, follow up on unresolved complaints, and make sure no important review is left unattended.



**We value actual results, productivity, and initiative—not just logged working hours.**



### What We Offer



- Fully remote work opportunity.

- Flexible schedule of approximately 2–3 hours per day.

- Opportunity for a long-term working relationship based on performance.

- Training on our internal processes and review management procedures.

- Supportive team environment.



### How to Apply



Please send your resume and a brief cover letter highlighting your experience in customer service, Trustpilot, online reputation management, or similar work.



In your application, please answer these questions:



1. Have you managed Trustpilot reviews before? If yes, how many accounts or stores?

2. Do you know how to identify and flag fake or suspicious Trustpilot reviews? Briefly explain your process.

3. How do you handle a negative review from a customer who has not responded to previous
s?

4. Are you comfortable working 2–3 hours per day and submitting weekly performance reports?

5. What is your expected hourly rate?



**Important:** 

Include the word **"trust"** in your application subject or introduction so we know you have read the entire job description.



We look forward to receiving your application!

- Keeping bookkeeping records and supporting documents organized

- Flagging anything unusual or anything you need clarification on

- Preparing monthly reports

- Making sure the books are complete and ready for my accountant at year-end



My goal is to be very hands-off with the bookkeeping. Ideally, once a month you would send me anything that requires my input or categorization, I would review it, and you would handle the rest.

- Highly organized, accurate, and reliable

- Comfortable working independently and proactively

- Strong in written and spoken English so we can communicate clearly and easily

- Interested in a long-term working relationship



Estimated workload: Around 10–15 hours per month, with most of the work likely happening around month-end.

2. Whether you've worked with Canadian businesses and GST/HST before

4. Please begin your application with the word MAPLE so I know you've read the full posting.

ai.sales.engine

title: Basic Video Editor
description:
MAKE SURE TO APPLY HERE: 

About Exchange Life



Exchange Life is a fast-growing e-commerce travel jewelry brand. We sell collectible country charms for travelers, with new products launching soon. Our content team of editors, filmmakers, and creators works fully remotely.



We're hiring an editor who can own their output and be creative within proven marketing fundamentals. This is a long-term engagement, not a one-off project. Many of our editors have worked with us for two or more years. You'll collaborate with our Content Lead and Marketing team.



What success looks like



Within three to six months, you're consistently producing short-form videos that perform on both paid and organic channels, hitting 50%+ thumb-stop rates and 30%+ hold rates, and iterating on winning formats independently.

Edit TikTok and Reels content optimized for hook rate, retention, and watch time

Deliver approximately
edits per month against agreed briefs

Highly skilled in CapCut Pro or a comparable editing tool

Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English, as all briefs and team communication are in English

Experience editing for e-commerce brands

Experience interpreting paid ad metrics and understanding what drives performance

Independent contractor engagement, paid in USD on a fixed monthly fee

title: Head Of Design
description:
MAKE SURE TO APPLY HERE: 



Lead Graphic Designer (DTC / Ecommerce)

Pay: $10 - $20/hour + performance bonuses (monthly earnings can be doubled with bonuses).



We’re looking for an experienced, all-round design lead who we can trust with almost any design problem, from product imagery and packaging to advertising creatives and reviewing the work of other designers.



This is a senior, hands-on role for someone with strong commercial taste who can take ownership rather than simply wait for design tickets and instructions.



What You’ll Own

You’ll be responsible for creating and improving visual work across our ecommerce brands, including:



Product imagery for PDPs, packshots, and lifestyle creatives

Packaging design

Occasional Meta and static advertising creatives

AI-generated product and lifestyle imagery

Text-in-image creatives with strong typography and composition

Reviewing work from other designers and providing clear, actionable feedback

Maintaining and raising the overall visual quality of the brand

You’ll both design and lead. We want someone who can spot when something isn't good enough, explain why, and help turn it into something better.



Who We’re Looking For

You should have:



Strong experience in ecommerce or commercial product design

A portfolio demonstrating product-focused work, not primarily logos or branding projects

Excellent visual judgment, composition, typography, and attention to detail

Strong AI image-generation and editing skills

Experience creating convincing AI product/lifestyle imagery

Strong text-in-image skills

The ability to independently solve design problems

Experience reviewing other designers' work and giving useful feedback

A proactive approach. You should be comfortable suggesting improvements instead of waiting to be told exactly what to do.

Nice to Have

Agency or design studio experience

DTC ecommerce experience

Experience with jewelry, gifts, pet products, or other physical consumer products

Strong Figma skills

Advanced image compositing and retouching workflows

Experience designing high-converting ecommerce product pages or ad creatives

What This Role Is Not

This is not a basic graphic designer position and we're not looking for someone who primarily creates logos.



We need someone capable of owning commercial design work from concept through final execution and helping other designers improve their output.



Compensation

$10 to $20/hour + performance bonuses.



Strong performance is rewarded significantly, and monthly earnings can be doubled with bonuses.

title: Amazon Wholesale VA / Brand Sourcer / Supplier Outreach Specialist
description:
About the Role:



I’m looking for a reliable and motivated Amazon Wholesale Virtual Assistant to join my team and help grow my Amazon business.



The ideal candidate has experience with the Amazon Wholesale business model, particularly in brand sourcing, supplier research, distributor sourcing, and supplier outreach.



You should be comfortable identifying profitable wholesale opportunities, researching brands and distributors, analyzing Amazon listings, and reaching out to potential suppliers to open wholesale accounts.



I’m looking for someone who can become a long-term member of the team, continuously improve their sourcing skills, and consistently help us build strong supplier relationships and profitable wholesale opportunities.



What you’ll do:

As an Amazon Wholesale VA, your main responsibilities will include:



- Researching profitable brands and products to sell on Amazon

- Finding authorized distributors, wholesalers, and direct brand opportunities

- Conducting brand and supplier research

- Reaching out to brands, distributors, and suppliers via email, phone, or contact forms

- Following up with suppliers and tracking responses

- Requesting wholesale applications, catalogs, price lists, and account information

- Analyzing supplier price lists for profitable Amazon opportunities

- Reviewing Amazon listings, Buy Box history, sales rank, competition, and pricing trends

- Analyzing Keepa graphs and historical product data

- Using SellerAmp SAS and other wholesale research tools to evaluate ROI, profit, fees, competition, and sales potential

- Checking whether brands and products meet our sourcing criteria

- Organizing brands, suppliers, contacts, price lists, and product leads in Google Sheets

- Maintaining accurate records of supplier outreach and account status

- Communicating regularly about progress, opportunities, and challenges



What I’m Looking For

- Experience with the Amazon Wholesale business model

- Experience with brand sourcing and supplier research

- Experience contacting brands, distributors, and wholesalers

- Strong understanding of Keepa

- Experience using SellerAmp SAS

- Ability to analyze Amazon listings and product profitability

- Experience reviewing wholesale price lists

- Familiarity with Amazon Seller Central

- Strong Google search and online research skills

- Proficiency with Google Sheets and Google Workspace

- Good written and verbal communication skills

- Professional supplier outreach and follow-up skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to follow sourcing criteria and SOPs

- Ability to work independently

- Reliable and professional work ethic

- Willingness to learn and continuously improve



Experience with tools such as SmartScout, ScanUnlimited, RevSeller, or similar Amazon Wholesale tools is a plus.



There will also be opportunities to learn additional Amazon Wholesale skills as you grow within the role.



To apply for the job:

1. Change the subject line to 'I want to be your Amazon Wholesale VA'

2. In the first 2-3 sentences of your message, tell us what excites you most about this role and what makes you a great fit.

3. Then, answer these questions with the numbers:



A) Describe your experience with Amazon Wholesale, preferably with brand sourcing, distributor research, and supplier outreach. Be specific about the tasks you handled.



B) If a supplier sends you a price list with hundreds or thousands of products, explain how you would analyze it and identify profitable opportunities.



C) What makes you stand out from other applicants? What unique value would you bring to the team?



Note: Only applicants who follow ALL instructions will be considered.



I look forward to reading what you provide.



Thank you!

- Understanding of FBA fees, ROI vs margin, Buy Box dynamics and sales rank

- Knowledge of Amazon restrictions, gating and IP risk

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills

- Excellent written English for supplier outreach

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and the ability to work independently

-Experience with UK/EU marketplaces

- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

- Take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved.

, and Expedia**.

Experience managing 20 or more vacation rental properties is a strong advantage.

## Salary & Benefits



**Fixed Monthly Salary: $600 USD**



**Performance Bonuses – Twice Per Year**



We offer the opportunity to earn up to **one additional month's salary ($600 USD) every six months**, depending on individual performance and KPI achievement.



Performance bonuses will be assessed based on:



- OTA listing quality and optimization.

- Accuracy and reliability of PMS/OTA connections.

- Pricing optimization and revenue management performance.

- Prevention and resolution of synchronization issues.

- Speed and effectiveness of technical problem-solving.

- Operational efficiency and independence.

title: Short form Content Creator
description:
If your showreel is full of zoom punches, whoosh sounds, emoji pop-ups and captions bouncing all over the screen, this is not the job for you.

We want an editor who trusts the message enough to get out of its way.



Who We Are



Mojo Human Performance Institute is a leadership and performance company that works with scaling business owners. Our founder, Michael Mojo, helps them become the leader their business actually needs.

Our podcast is live and pulling global names into the room. We run live events through the year, we coach founders every week, and we have a community of business owners who hold each other to a higher standard. All of it gets captured.

What we say matters. The way it gets cut has to match.



What We Mean By "Not Overly Animated"



Most coaching content online looks the same. Loud, busy, chopped to pieces, built to stop a thumb and say nothing. We have tried that style. It does not sound like us and it does not land with the people we serve.

This is the most important part of this ad, so read it twice.



What we want:



• Clean cuts that let a point breathe.

• Captions that are readable, consistent and on brand. Not every word flashing a different colour.

• B-roll and graphics only when they add meaning, never to fill space.

• Music that sits under the voice, never on top of it.

• Hooks built from what was actually said, not from sound effects.



What we do not want:



• Constant zooms, shakes and transitions.

• Meme inserts, emoji overlays and stacked sound effects.

• Trend formats forced onto serious content.

• Clickbait captions that promise more than the clip delivers.



If you can make a 40 second clip of someone talking feel gripping with almost nothing added, you are who we are looking for.



What You Will Do



• Cut short form for Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn from podcast, coaching, event and behind the scenes footage.

• Find the moments. Timestamps will be flagged, but the best clips are often the ones nobody noticed. Watch properly and spot them.

• Own the first two seconds. That is where a clip lives or dies.

• Work to the Mojo brand, not to trends. Content that gets views but does not sound like us is a fail here, not a win.

• Deliver volume, consistently. This is a lot of good work every week, not one beautiful edit a fortnight.

• Keep the edit pipeline organised so nothing sits waiting.

• Review clip performance with the Content Lead and use the numbers to get better.



You Need To Understand Coaching



This is not a niche you are passing through. You need to get the coaching and personal development space.

You know the difference between a genuine leadership insight and motivational filler. You have watched enough business and self development content to know what feels credible and what feels like a guru selling a course. You can tell when a moment in a session is real, and you know how to protect it in the edit.

If you are into self development yourself, even better. You will hear coaching every day that founders pay serious money for.



Culture Fit: Our Standards



We hire on these as much as on skill. They are the four standards Michael has set for the whole team, and you will be held to them from day one.



Lead yourself first. You manage your own time, energy and workload. You do not wait to be chased. When you get something wrong, you own it and fix it.

Deliver the outcome. Effort is not the measure. Finished, published clips that do their job are.

Communicate with intent. Say what you mean, and say it early. If a deadline is at risk, we hear about it before it is missed, with a solution attached.

Define the greater impact. Every clip reaches a business owner who might be stuck. Edit like that matters, because it does.



Who You Are



• You have a portfolio of short form you have cut, and it shows restraint as much as skill.

• You are fast and consistent. Good and done beats perfect and Thursday.

• You take feedback without taking it personally. There will be plenty early on.

• You are comfortable in Premiere, DaVinci, CapCut or similar, including captions and basic audio clean up.

• You are happy in the building at Hendon every day and can travel for events. This role is not remote or hybrid.



Who You Are Not



• An editor whose style is the star of the show.

• Someone who chases the trend over the brand. We have been burned by this before.

• Someone who needs to be left alone for a week. This is a team seat with daily contact.

• Someone who sees coaching content as just another client category.



What You Get



• Proper training from people who care about this craft.

• More reps in a year than most editors get in three.

• Access to rooms you would not otherwise be in.

• A growing team, with room to grow inside it.

title: Creative Strategist / Copywriter — Long-Form Meta Native Ads
description:
Creative Strategist / Copywriter — Long-Form Meta Native Ads (Supplements)



Full-time | Remote | DTC supplement brand 



ONLY APPLY IF ALL THREE ARE TRUE



1. You have written long-form native ads for Meta before. Not
s,

   not SMS, not SEO or blog posts, not social captions, not short-form

   UGC scripts. Natives — 1,500 to 2,500 words, written to read like a

   real person's story, that ran as paid ads. If you haven't written

   one, we won't reply.



2. You understand copywriting. You can name the structure you're using

   and say why. Mechanism, false close, why the third paragraph matters

   more than the first. Not "I'm creative" — the craft.



3. You're hungry. We ship, read the numbers, rewrite. If you need

   chasing or two weeks per piece, we'll both be miserable.



THE ROLE



We sell supplements and run long-form natives on Meta. Seven figures a

year behind them. We already know what wins — proven structures, hooks

and angles, with real spend behind them.



What we don't have is one person who owns it end to end. Right now the

research, writing and iteration are split across several people.



You'd take a product, work out the story, write it yourself, and keep

rewriting until it beats the control. Strategy and writing both — you

don't brief someone else.



Also: building segment-specific versions of a winner (same core story,

rebuilt for a different audience with its own reasoning), pulling apart

what competitors are scaling, and reading the account to work out why

something died.



WHAT WE WANT



- Near-native English. These live or die on voice. If a sentence reads

  like it was written rather than typed, it doesn't work.

- You can read an ad report and tell us what it means

- You work independently. We give you structures and data, not a daily

  task list.



Nice to have: supplements, pet or health experience. Comfortable with

compliance — you know which claims you can make and which you can't.



THE OFFER



Full-time, long-term. Competitive salary reviewed at 3 months.

Performance bonus tied to ads that scale. You'll see real spend data,

so you'll know whether your work is working.



HOW TO APPLY



1. Two long-form natives you wrote that ran as paid ads on Meta — with

   rough spend or how long they ran.

2. One paragraph: pick any supplement. What single angle would you lead

   with, and why that one over the obvious one?

3. Put COLLAR in your subject line.



We read everything that follows those three steps. Nothing that doesn't.

title: Senior Legal Recruiter
description:
Senior Legal Recruiter

Full-Time | Fully Remote | Philippines-Based | Direct Hire with U.S. Client



About the Opportunity



Alderstone Partners is representing a U.S. recruitment firm seeking an experienced Senior Legal Recruiter based in the Philippines to join its team directly and support attorney recruitment across multiple states.



This is a full-time, direct-hire opportunity with the client organization. The successful candidate will be employed directly by the client, not Alderstone Partners.



We are seeking a recruiter with demonstrated experience in the U.S. legal market, particularly in identifying, engaging, and evaluating attorneys across different legal practice areas.



The ideal candidate understands the distinctions between legal specializations, attorney seniority levels, and law firm hiring requirements. Beyond sourcing, this role requires sound candidate judgment, professional communication, discretion, and the ability to manage specialized attorney searches independently.



What You'll Do

* Source and engage qualified attorneys for U.S. law firms and legal practices, primarily across multiple states.

* Conduct targeted searches for Associate Attorneys, Senior Associates, Counsel, Partners, and other legal professionals based on client requirements.

* Identify candidates with relevant practice area experience, professional credentials, jurisdictional admissions, and appropriate levels of seniority.

* Conduct candidate outreach through LinkedIn,
, phone, professional networks, and other approved sourcing channels.

* Screen prospective candidates to assess their legal practice background, years of experience, bar admissions, compensation expectations, career interests, and geographic preferences.

* Develop and maintain attorney pipelines across assigned legal specializations.

* Conduct Boolean searches, competitor research, and targeted talent mapping within law firms and legal markets.

* Evaluate candidate alignment with specific practice groups, client requirements, and professional backgrounds.

* Manage multiple attorney searches and maintain consistent candidate engagement throughout the recruitment process.

* Coordinate interviews and communicate professionally with candidates, hiring managers, law firm representatives, and other stakeholders.

* Maintain accurate candidate records, confidential information, recruitment notes, and pipeline updates within ATS or CRM systems.

* Support candidates throughout the interview and offer process while maintaining discretion and professionalism.

* Deliver consistent recruitment activity and results without compromising candidate quality.



What We're Looking For

* Proven experience recruiting attorneys or legal professionals for the U.S. market.

* Previous experience supporting U.S. law firms, legal recruitment agencies, executive search firms, or specialized legal staffing organizations.

* Strong understanding of attorney recruitment, including legal practice areas, professional qualifications, and law firm hiring structures.

* Experience sourcing and screening attorneys across different seniority levels.

* Familiarity with U.S. bar admission requirements and their relevance to attorney hiring.

* Ability to distinguish between legal specializations and evaluate candidates beyond general legal industry experience.

* Strong direct sourcing, Boolean search, and candidate outreach capabilities.

* Experience identifying passive candidates and developing relationships with legal professionals.

* Excellent written and spoken English communication.

* Confidence communicating directly with U.S. attorneys, law firm representatives, and hiring stakeholders.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple searches independently.

* Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS platforms, recruiting databases, and other sourcing tools.

* Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive candidate and client information.

* Availability to support U.S. business hours based on client requirements.



Preferred Legal Recruitment Specializations

We are particularly interested in recruiters who have experience sourcing and placing attorneys within one or more of the following U.S. legal practice areas.



Litigation and Dispute Resolution

* Civil Litigation

* Commercial Litigation

* Insurance Defense

* Personal Injury

* Medical Malpractice

* Employment Litigation

* Construction Litigation



Corporate and Transactional Law

* Corporate Law

* Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A)

* Business Transactions

* Banking and Finance

* Securities and Capital Markets

* Commercial Real Estate

* Corporate Governance



Specialized Legal Practices

* Labor and Employment

* Intellectual Property and Patent Law

* Immigration Law

* Family Law

* Estate Planning and Probate

* Bankruptcy and Restructuring

* Tax Law

* Healthcare Law

* Data Privacy and Cybersecurity

* Regulatory Compliance



Experience recruiting attorneys across multiple practice areas is an advantage, particularly for recruiters who have supported specialized legal searches or lateral attorney recruitment.



Candidates are not expected to have experience in every practice area listed. We are primarily interested in the depth of your legal recruitment experience, your understanding of attorney qualifications, and your ability to identify suitable candidates for specific law firm requirements.



What We Value

We are especially interested in legal recruiters who demonstrate:



* Legal Market Understanding: Familiarity with U.S. law firm structures, attorney specializations, and the qualifications associated with different practice areas.

* Candidate Judgment: The ability to assess an attorney's relevant practice experience, credentials, seniority, and suitability for a specific opportunity.

* Sourcing Expertise: Strong research skills and the ability to identify qualified attorneys, including those who are not actively seeking new opportunities.

* Professional Communication: Clear, thoughtful, and discreet communication with legal professionals and hiring stakeholders.

* Relationship Building: The ability to establish credibility and maintain professional relationships with attorneys throughout the recruitment process.

* Ownership: The ability to manage specialized searches independently, maintain organized pipelines, and follow through consistently.

* Consistency: Reliable execution across sourcing, candidate assessment, outreach, documentation, and recruitment outcomes.



Compensation

PHP 50,000 to PHP 100,000 per month



Final compensation will depend on relevant legal recruitment experience, U.S. market exposure, attorney sourcing expertise, practice area specialization, communication skills, and overall alignment with the client's requirements.



Employment Structure

This is a direct-hire opportunity with Alderstone Partners' client.

The selected candidate will join and work directly with the client organization.

This is not a temporary staffing assignment, and the selected candidate will not be employed or payrolled by Alderstone Partners.

Alderstone Partners facilitates the search, candidate assessment, introduction, and hiring process. The client organization retains responsibility for the final hiring decision and employment arrangement.

title: Accountant | 6-Month Contract
description:
About Us



Mad Mex is back to its OG roots! Fighting for Flavour, Defending for Freshness, and always bringing a Por El Sabor (for the flavour) attitude to everything we do.



We’re not here to play it safe or serve bland, boring “Mexican”. We’re here to bring big, bold, unapologetically Mexican flavours to Australia and build the most loved Mexican brand in the country while we do it.



With over 75 restaurants and growing fast, we’re entering our next phase of growth, investing in our brand, story, culture and familia, and bigger, bolder ways to bring Por El Sabor to life.



About the Role



We’re looking for an Accountant to join us on a 6-month contract, with the potential to become permanent for the right person. You’ll own our Payroll and Bank Reconciliation processes and keep the numbers behind every restaurant accurate and on time. You’ll also back up the wider Finance team and help shape how we use AI and automation to work smarter.





What You’ll Be Doing



Payroll



- Own the end-to-end payroll process, from timesheet validation and pay runs through to releasing pay and lodging STP.

- Pay super and PAYG, and prepare, lodge and pay payroll tax in line with statutory and company deadlines.

- Deliver the weekly labour report on time and reconcile payroll balance sheet accounts.

- Manage the payroll inbox and respond to internal and ad hoc payroll queries.

- Liaise with our Workers Compensation insurer on annual lodgements and declarations across states and entities.

- Drive continuous improvement in payroll processes.



Bank & Revenue Reconciliations



- Complete daily bank reconciliations, investigating unmatched deposits and missing bankings with Business Managers.

- Reconcile petty cash weekly, confirm till floats by store monthly, and reconcile credit cards monthly back to the GL.

- Reconcile cash receipts, EFTPOS and Windcave online order receipts, and assist with delivery reconciliations when required.



Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable & Reporting



- Support AP, including booking invoices in NetSuite, validating the weekly AP export from TASK, reconciling supplier statements, and processing AP and rent payments.

- Support AR, including raising royalty, marketing fee and ad hoc invoices, processing direct debits and following up the AR ageing.

- Manage the shared Accounts inbox daily and support cash flow reporting.

- Own assigned period end tasks and monthly balance sheet reconciliations, and support audits with accurate, timely reports.

- Deliver ad hoc projects and special reports that give the business sharper insights.



AI, Automation & System Transformation



- Support our Finance AI automation project by documenting current processes and identifying manual pain points and automation opportunities.

- Act as a finance subject matter expert, translating accounting and compliance requirements into clear business rules for the project team and technology partners.

- Assist with solution design, UAT, data validation and parallel runs to make sure automated outputs are accurate and compliant.

- Help maintain controls, approvals, audit trails and exception handling in automated workflows.

- Support data quality and master data clean-up across NetSuite, payroll and related systems.

- Update procedures, prepare training materials and help the Finance team adopt new tools and processes.





What You Bring



- 3+ years’ accounting experience, including end-to-end payroll and bank reconciliations (hospitality preferred).

- Qualifications in accounting, business or commerce.

- Sound knowledge of Australian payroll requirements, including STP, superannuation, PAYG, payroll tax and workers compensation.

- Experience with ERP and payroll systems; Oracle NetSuite, Tanda and KeyPay preferred.

-Broad exposure across AP, AR, bank and revenue reconciliations, period end and balance sheet reconciliations.

-A strong interest in AI and automation within finance, with the ability to document processes and support testing and adoption of new tools. System transformation experience is preferred.

- Intermediate to advanced Excel skills (macros, XLOOKUPs); Power Query preferred.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.

- Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong organisation and time management, with the ability to meet deadlines under pressure and work independently or in a team.

- A stable internet connection for remote work.

- Most importantly, you’re curious, adaptable and ready to Own It.



Why Mad Mex?



You’ll join a fast-growing Familia where Finance directly supports our restaurants, our people and our franchise partners.



There’s plenty of opportunity to learn, innovate, improve and grow into new areas of the department.



Bring your numbers game. Bring your curiosity for automation. Bring the Por El Sabor.





Please include a link to your CV and your monthly salary expectations with your application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. We can’t wait to see the spice you’ll bring to the table!

title: Executive Assistant & GoHighLevel Specialist
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT & GOHIGHLEVEL SPECIALIST

MAXCREDIT | Remote | Part-Time with Opportunity to Grow Full-Time

Hours: Initially 20 hours per week

Schedule: Consistent availability during agreed U.S. Eastern business hours

Growth: Opportunity to transition into full-time as performance and business needs support it



ABOUT THE ROLE
