We're looking for a proactive, organized assistant to work directly with the founder. Your purpose is to free up the founder's time for lead acquisition, relationship building, and sales by keeping conversations, tasks, and daily operations moving forward.



You should be comfortable taking ownership, identifying the next step, and following through without repeated reminders. Strong communication, hands-on GoHighLevel experience, and practical ChatGPT skills are essential.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Management

• Follow up with warm leads, past inquiries, networking contacts, and prospects who have stopped responding.

• Ask approved qualification questions and book qualified sales calls.

• Keep conversations moving toward a clear next step.

• Handle appointment confirmations, reschedules, and no-show follow-ups.

• Keep contact records, conversation notes, opportunities, and follow-up tasks accurate in GoHighLevel.



Cold Outreach & Referral Coordination

• Research prospective clients and potential referral partners.

• Send personalized outreach through approved channels using company guidelines.

• Follow up with interested contacts and book introductory calls.

• Track outreach, responses, appointments, and next steps in GHL.

• Request reviews and referrals from satisfied clients using approved processes.

• Maintain referral partner records and track referral payments due.



GoHighLevel Management & Automations

• Manage contacts, conversations, pipelines, calendars, tags, custom fields, and tasks.

• Build, update, test, and troubleshoot workflows.

• Maintain appointment reminders, follow-up sequences, and response-based automations.

• Identify missed follow-ups, duplicate messages, workflow errors, and inaccurate records.

• Test and document automation changes before activation.



Executive & Administrative Support

• Organize the founder's inbox, flag important messages, draft replies, and track outstanding responses.

• Complete delegated tasks in Asana and keep deadlines and statuses current.

• Coordinate with team members and follow up on outstanding deliverables.

• Flag blockers early and clearly explain what is needed to move forward.

• Research assigned topics and provide concise, useful summaries.

• Document recurring tasks and maintain simple operating procedures.

• Handle additional administrative tasks according to agreed priorities.



Client Onboarding & Coordination

• Send approved onboarding instructions and follow up on missing documents or information.

• Coordinate handoffs to the appropriate team member.

• Answer routine process questions using approved information.

• Provide verified status updates and escalate questions requiring specialist judgment.

• Handle client and business information confidentially.



Daily Reporting

• Send a brief update covering completed work, outreach, follow-ups, appointments booked, blockers, and decisions needed.

• Maintain accurate activity records to support weekly reporting.



Daily follow-ups and scheduled client needs take priority. Larger automation projects will be planned around available hours.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Hands-on experience using GoHighLevel beyond basic contact entry.

• Ability to build and troubleshoot workflows using triggers, conditions, wait steps, and workflow exits.

• Strong written English and the ability to communicate naturally and professionally.

• Experience with follow-ups, appointment setting, outreach, or customer communication.

• Practical ChatGPT skills for drafting, research, organization, and problem-solving.

• Ability to review AI-generated work for accuracy, tone, and relevance.

• Experience with Asana or a similar task management platform.

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and independent follow-through.

• Reliable internet, a suitable workspace, and dependable availability.



Credit repair or business funding experience is helpful but not required. We will teach our services and internal processes. You should already be comfortable using GHL.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

• Leads receive timely follow-ups during scheduled working hours.

• Active conversations have a clear next action.

• Outreach is personalized, consistent, and tracked.

• Appointments are booked accurately and followed through.

• Client onboarding progresses without unnecessary delays.

• Tasks are completed on time, with blockers communicated early.

• GHL records stay organized and automation changes are tested.

• The founder spends less time chasing updates and handling routine administration.



DO NOT APPLY IF

• You are still learning the basics of GoHighLevel.

• You need repeated reminders to complete assigned work.

• You send AI-generated messages without reviewing them.

• You cannot demonstrate a workflow you built or explain how it works.

• You cannot commit to consistent scheduled hours.



HOW TO APPLY

Use the subject line: MAXCREDIT Assistant – [Your Name]



Please include:

1. Your resume and a brief explanation of your relevant experience.

2. A short video demonstrating a GHL workflow you built, what it does, and how you tested it. Use a demo account or remove confidential information.

3. One practical example of how you use ChatGPT at work.

4. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time, earliest start date, and desired hourly rate within the advertised range.

5. Two short writing samples:

   • A follow-up text to someone who requested credit repair information three days ago but has not responded.

   • An introductory message to a potential referral partner.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief paid practical assessment using sample information and a test environment.



We're looking for a dependable person who wants to take ownership and grow with MAXCREDIT over time.

Everything you need to know about how this works, how you get paid, and what we expect is in that video. Somewhere in it, I say a secret word. Put that word in the first line of your application. Applications without it get deleted without being read.



---



You've made ads that made other people rich. This time, you get a cut.



Right now, somewhere, an ad you edited is still making money for a brand that paid you once and forgot your name. You got $20, $30, maybe $50. They got the sales.



We think that's backwards.



CORVIA is a fast-growing heart-health supplement brand. We're building a team of 100 AI video ad editors, and we're paying them like partners. We run your ad with our money. If it sells, you earn 10% of every sale it brings in, for as long as it keeps selling.



AI ISN'T COMING FOR YOUR JOB HERE. IT'S YOUR WEAPON.



Everyone is scared AI will replace editors. We think the opposite. The editors who master AI tools and understand what makes people buy are about to be the most valuable people in advertising. We want those people, and we'll pay them like it.



HOW IT WORKS



1. We give you the inspiration. Proven winning ads from our market, the hooks that work, and a clear brief. No guessing, no blank page.

2. You make it better. Keep the psychology and the story that already sells, then add CORVIA's unique mechanism, sharper hooks and stronger AI visuals. Then make your own originals.

3. We test it with real money. The best ads go live at $100/day in ad spend.

4. Winners scale, and so do you. If your ad keeps bringing in customers at our target cost, we keep raising the budget. More spend means more sales, and more commission for you.



WHAT ONE WINNING AD CAN BE WORTH TO YOU



- Ad scaled to $1,000/day in spend: about $2,700/month in commission

- Ad scaled to $5,000/day: about $13,600/month

- Ad scaled to $10,000/day: about $27,000/month



That's from one ad, and you can have several running at once. These are examples, not promises: most ads won't win. The ones that do pay like nothing else in this industry.



PAY



- $5/hour base while you create (up to 4 hours per ad), so you're paid from day one

- 10% commission on net sales from every ad of yours we run

- Extra commission when you make variations of a winning ad

- Paid twice a month, on fixed dates, via Wise or Payoneer

- You can see how your ads are selling, so you never have to wonder what you're owed



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Make 1 AI video ad per day, from 30 seconds to 5 minutes

- Remake proven winners into better CORVIA versions, then create your own

- Build hooks and variations of our current winning ads

- Formats: AI UGC-style, AI presenter, B-roll story ads, character skits (sitcom, story-driven)

- Follow our ad rules: no fake doctors, no fake customer reviews, no disease claims. We'll train you on them.



YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU



- Have made short-form or direct-response ads before

- Use AI video tools like Arcads, HeyGen, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, CapCut or Premiere

- Know a hook from a headline, and know why people stop scrolling

- Can ship every day, take feedback, and want to be measured on results

- Have strong English and reliable internet



HOW TO GET PICKED



We only take the best. Here's how to show us:



1. WATCH THE LOOM VIDEO: 
  This is mandatory. Put the secret word from the video in the first line of your application.

2. Send your 3 best ads. Real ads you made, with links, plus any results you know (views, ROAS, sales).

3. List the AI tools you use and how fast you can turn around an ad.

4. Shortlisted editors get a paid test ($25). We send you a winning ad, and you make a better one for CORVIA.

5. The best tests get hired. You start making ads that week.



No secret word = no review. That's how we know who's serious.

title: YouTube Video Editor (BEST ONLY)
description:
Hey, I'm Giovanni!



I'm looking for a long-form video editor to team up with me and grow my YouTube channel, TechGio. This is the most important hire I'm making for the channel. If you love clean, premium tech content and you're excited about AI, keep reading. I think you're going to like this one!



ABOUT THE CHANNEL



I work in tech sales, and TechGio started as me documenting my own path into the industry and helping others break in with no experience. That's still part of it, but the channel is expanding into something bigger: the AI and tech industry, the tools I actually use every day (Grok Bot, Claude, AI agents, and whatever comes next), and the behind-the-scenes of building my own AI startup while working full-time.



So the mix is: talking-head, screen recordings of real tools and workflows, and founder journey content. All long-form, all YouTube.



THE STYLE I'M GOING FOR



The best tech channels right now share a format: clean talking-head plus screen recordings that are actually easy to follow. Cursor highlights, smooth zooms, crisp on-screen text, diagrams that make technical ideas simple. Premium and calm, not flashy.



Channels that nail it:

• Chris Raroque (closest to the exact style I want)

• Nate Herk | AI Automation

• Alex Finn

• Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies



Three videos that show the exact look:


/watch?v=UyMJBUCyDIs


/watch?v=jwogmXNt7o4


/watch?v=IsUpatC9obI



You can also check my channel to see how previous videos were edited: 



If you watch these and think "I can edit at that level," you're who I'm looking for. Please watch a few before you apply!



WHAT YOU'LL DO



I batch-film, so you'll get raw talking-head footage, screen recordings, and a short brief per video (hook, structure, key moments). From there, you own the edit:

• Trim and pace. Cut dead air and bad takes, keep the energy up. Retention is the job.

• On-screen text. Captions, callouts, key numbers, lists. Sharp and well-timed.

• Screen recordings. Zooms, cursor highlights, clean cuts between me and the screen.

• Simple motion graphics. Diagrams for AI concepts, tool highlights, transitions.

• Music, sound design, color, and final export.

• Revisions from my timestamped notes. Usually one round.



Deliverables: finished video plus organized project files.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



• Experienced with long-form YouTube. You've edited talking-head + screen recording content before and can show me published videos. Please don't apply if your portfolio is mostly Shorts, gaming, or events. Nothing against that work, it's just a different job.

• Passionate about AI and tech. You follow the space, or genuinely want to. It shows in the edit when the editor gets the content.

• You use AI in your workflow. Descript, auto-captions, AI features in Premiere or Resolve, whatever makes you faster and better. My whole operation runs on AI.

• Strong with text and motion. Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve plus After Effects (or equivalent).

• Fast and reliable. First cut within 48 hours of getting footage. 24 hours is the goal. If something is going to slip, I hear about it before it does.

• Willing to adapt and learn. The tech space moves fast and the channel will evolve with it. I want someone who grows with me, takes feedback well, and cares whether the video performs.

• Clear communicator. Fluent written English, responsive on Slack or WhatsApp, comfortable working async.



PAY AND WHAT YOU GET



$50–$100 per video depending on experience and quality. We start at 2 videos a week and grow from there.



This is a long-term partnership, not a one-off gig:

• Consistent volume that grows with the channel.

• Rate increases tied to quality and consistency. Good work gets rewarded!

• Tools covered. I'm open to paying for software, plugins, or assets you need.

• First look at everything that comes next: startup launch content, product videos, and more.

• A real seat at the table. I want your ideas on hooks, pacing, and style.



QUICK FACTS



• Paid per video: $50–$100

• 2 videos a week to start

• First cut within 48 hours (24-hour goal)

• Long-form YouTube only. No Shorts.

• Slack or WhatsApp for communication



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "GROK" so I know you read the whole thing.



Then send me:

1. 3 links to long-form YouTube videos you edited (talking-head + screen recording preferred) and exactly what you did on each.

2. Which of the reference videos above is closest to your style, and one or two sentences on why.

3. Your tools, including which AI tools you use.

4. How many 10–15 minute videos per week you can realistically deliver, and your typical first-cut turnaround.

5. Your rate per video.



The strongest applicants get a paid test edit before we commit to anything, so you get paid either way.



I need portfolio links to consider you, so please don't skip those. Excited to see your work!

title: Lead Nurture Specialist (SMS + Phone)
description:
Lead Nurture Specialist (SMS + Phone) – $1,000/month – Sun–Fri, 9am–5pm EST – US company, direct hire



Full-time · Long-term · Work from home · Night shift (Philippines time 9pm–5am)



Read this first



This is a $1,000/month role, and we’ll be picky. If your spoken English isn’t near-native, if you’ve never worked US night hours, or if you need Sundays off, this isn’t the one. If you’re the person who gets told “you don’t sound Filipino on the phone” and you’re tired of being paid like everyone else on the floor, keep reading.



Who we are



The Hustlers Academy teaches people how to build Amazon stores. We run a live training every Sunday night (EST) and about 1,000 new people register for it each week. We’ve been doing this weekly for years, we spend real money on ads to fill it, and we have a sales team of setters and closers behind it. This is not a startup figuring it out. The role exists because show rate is the number that moves the whole business, and we want one person who owns it.



What you’ll own



You are the first human every registrant hears from. Your job runs from the moment they sign up to the moment they show up, apply, and book a call with our team.



Monday to Friday: text new registrants from our shared number. Short, casual, personal, written to get a reply. When they reply, you run the conversation: answer questions about the training, handle “I can’t make it Sunday” and “is this legit,” find out what they actually want, keep them warm.

Sunday: you’re on the phone. Confirmation calls to registrants during your shift, then texts through the afternoon so the room is full at 8pm EST.

Every day: hand hot leads to our setters inside Close CRM with notes, and post your numbers in Slack at the end of your shift.



You’ll be managing 100+ open conversations at a time. We’ll train you on our message framework, our CRM, and our scripts. We will not train you to sound natural in English. You either do or you don’t.



How you’ll be judged



Three numbers, visible to you every day: reply rate on your texts, show rate for the registrants you handled, and booked calls that started in your inbox. Hit them and you get the raise. Miss them for two months and we’ll both know.



Schedule



Sunday through Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm US Eastern. Saturday off.

In phillipine that’s 9:00pm to 5:00am (10:00pm to 6:00am from November to March). Sunday is the busiest day of the week and is not negotiable.



Pay and terms



$1,000/month, paid twice a month, on time, via your preferred method

Review at 90 days. 



Long-term. We’re not hiring for a project. The last people we hired for our sales team are still here.

You report directly to our operations lead, not an agency.



You’re a fit if



Your written English reads like an American texting a friend, and your spoken English is near-native with a neutral accent. We test both before any offer.

You’ve spent 1+ year texting or calling leads for a US company: appointment setting, lead follow-up, inbound sales, or a sales-adjacent support role

You type 50+ words per minute and can hold 100+ conversations without dropping one

You’re warm but not soft. Some leads will test you.

Reliable computer, fast internet, backup power and backup internet. No exceptions on this one.

Nice to have: Close, GoHighLevel, HubSpot, or any SMS platform



How to apply



Start your message with the word FRIEND. Then send all five. Applications missing any of them won’t be opened.



A lead replies to your first text with “who is this?” Write exactly what you’d send back.

A lead replies “I can’t make it Sunday.” Write exactly what you’d send back.

Your typing test result (1-minute test from 
 or similar, screenshot or link)

In 3 to 5 sentences: the last job where you texted or called US leads, and what your numbers were

A voice recording (required). Read this out loud, then talk for 60 seconds about why you’re good at this: “Hey, it’s Maria from Jas’s team. Saw you grabbed a seat for Sunday’s training. Quick question so I can save you a spot, are you watching on your phone or laptop?”

HanoHano VA – [Your First Name]

title: Case Manager
description:
Summary

**Remote | California Lemon Law Firm | Full-Time



** We are a California law firm focused on lemon law and consumer protection litigation, and we are looking for a licensed attorney to join our team as a Case Manager.



This is a hands-on position for an attorney who can manage cases, communicate directly with clients, stay on top of deadlines, and move cases forward from intake through settlement.



## What You’ll Do

* Manage an assigned caseload from intake/retainer through settlement or resolution.

* Communicate directly with clients, provide case updates, answer routine questions, and maintain strong client relationships.

* Request, review, and organize documents and evidence from clients.

* Review purchase documents, repair orders, warranty records, service history, manufacturer communications, and other case-related documents.

* Analyze case facts and identify missing information, potential issues, and case strengths/weaknesses.

* Draft legal documents, including pleadings, discovery, meet-and-confer correspondence, declarations, motions, settlement documents, and other case-related correspondence.

* Prepare and file documents with the court and assist with e-filing as needed.

* Track case deadlines, hearings, discovery obligations, settlement deadlines, and other important dates.

* Coordinate with attorneys, paralegals, case managers, and other members of the team.

* Maintain accurate and organized case files and case-management records.

* Follow cases closely and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

* Escalate significant legal or case issues when attorney review or strategy decisions are needed.



## What We’re Looking For **Required:**



* An active attorney license in good standing.

* Experience handling lemon law cases OR civil litigation.

* Strong legal writing and analytical skills.

* Excellent communication and client-management skills.

* Ability to independently manage multiple cases and competing deadlines.

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

* Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

* Professional, responsive, and comfortable communicating directly with clients.



## Preferred

* Direct California lemon law experience.

* Experience handling cases from intake through settlement.

* Experience with pleadings, discovery, motions, settlement negotiations, and court filings.

* Experience using case-management software such as Filevine.

* Experience working in a remote law-firm environment.



## The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who can own their cases rather than simply complete individual assignments. You should be comfortable communicating with clients, reviewing documents, drafting legal work, managing deadlines, coordinating with the team, and keeping a case moving without needing to be reminded about every next step. If you have lemon law experience, that's a strong advantage. If you have solid civil litigation experience and can learn the firm's lemon law process, we are also interested in speaking with you.



## How to Apply



Please submit your resume and a brief introduction explaining your relevant lemon law or civil litigation experience.



### Important

Read Before Applying To confirm that you have read the entire job posting, include the word Citrus in the subject line of your application. Applications that do not include the code word may not be considered.

title: US Accounting Manager
description:
About Us



At Aline Accounting Partners, we’re building something special—a tax and accounting firm where you belong, and your career can thrive.We’re looking for a highly experienced Accounting Manager to join our growing team. This fully role focuses on reviewing, finalizing, and delivering financials for external clients. This role is ideal for someone who is strong in full-cycle accounting, and confident in ensuring financials are accurate, complete, and tax-ready.



Learn more about who we are and what we’re building: 



Why You'll Want to Join:



We offer benefits that go beyond the standard package, ensuring a healthy work-life balance and long-term financial security:



- 100% remote work setup, giving you the freedom to work where you're most productive.

-Yearly Bonus

- Paid Leaves and Holidays

- Professional development opportunities for continuous learning and long-term career advancement.



About the Role



We’re looking for an experienced Accounting Manager to join our growing team. This is a client-facing role focused on reviewing, finalizing, and delivering accurate financials for external clients while providing guidance and support to accounting team members.



The ideal candidate has strong US GAAP and full-cycle accounting knowledge, experience managing multiple client engagements, and the confidence to work directly with clients to discuss financial results, resolve accounting issues, and ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time.



We’re looking for someone who has started building their management experience and is ready to continue growing as a leader. You should be resourceful, proactive, and solutions-oriented, with the ability to investigate issues, find answers, and determine the appropriate next steps



What You'll Do

- Review and finalize financial statements and accounting deliverables for multiple external clients.

- Apply knowledge of US GAAP to ensure financials are accurate, complete, compliant, and tax-ready.

- Review general ledger activity, journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules, and other full-cycle accounting activities.

- Manage and oversee month-end and year-end close processes, ensuring client deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.

- Serve as a key point of contact for assigned clients, regularly participating in and leading client meetings via video calls, explaining financial results, resolving discrepancies, and addressing accounting-related questions.

- Manage multiple client engagements, priorities, and deadlines while maintaining consistent quality and service standards.

- Review the work of accountants and provide guidance on accounting matters, client deliverables, and day-to-day challenges.

- Research and investigate accounting issues and determine appropriate solutions or accounting treatment.

- Escalate complex technical accounting or client matters to senior leadership when appropriate.

- Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, workflows, documentation, and quality controls.

- Support the development of accounting team members through feedback, coaching, and hands-on guidance.



What We’re Looking For

- Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

- Strong accounting experience supporting US-based clients, preferably within an accounting, CPA, outsourced accounting, or professional services firm.

- At least 3 years of experience in an Accounting Manager, Assistant Manager, Team Lead, or similar early management role within an accounting environment.

- Experience reviewing the work of accountants and providing guidance, feedback, or day-to-day support to team members.

- Strong client-facing experience with the confidence to participate in and lead client discussions, explain financial information, investigate issues, and manage expectations.

- Experience managing multiple client accounts, preferably including complex or larger client engagements.

- Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and full-cycle accounting.

- Exposure to technical accounting matters; familiarity with topics such as ASC 606 (Revenue Recognition) and ASC 842 (Lease Accounting) is preferred.

- Government Contracting (GovCon) accounting experience is a plus.

- Experience with ERP and accounting systems; familiarity with QuickBooks and platforms such as NetSuite, Sage Intacct, SAP, Oracle, or similar systems is preferred.

- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to research, investigate, and resolve accounting issues independently.

- A resourceful and proactive mindset, with the ability to take initiative and determine the next best step.

- Strong attention to detail, organization, communication, and time-management skills.

- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a fully remote environment.



Why Aline Accounting Partners?



At Aline, we don’t just offer jobs—we provide careers with flexibility, growth, and meaningful opportunities to make an impact.



As an Accounting Manager, you’ll work with a variety of clients, strengthen your technical and client-facing expertise, and continue developing your leadership skills while helping ensure our clients receive accurate, timely, and high-quality accounting support.

• SketchUp: Preliminary architectural design and 3D models, particularly designs that can be brought into Revit and developed into native BIM elements.

• Twinmotion: Architectural renderings and walkthroughs.



Experience with BOTH Revit and Vectorworks is especially valuable. Tell us if you have used them together and how you exchanged or coordinated files. Also describe any projects where you developed a preliminary SketchUp design into a Revit model and construction documents.



You must communicate consistently, meet agreed deadlines, provide realistic time estimates and progress updates, and work using your own capable computer, software, and reliable internet.

1. Your résumé and a summary of your project and construction experience.

title: CEO
description:
About the Role



This is not a virtual assistant position. You will run our online channels the way a general manager runs a business. You will report directly to our CEO, lead a small team of platform specialists, and be responsible for one clear goal: building our online business to USD 3 million in annual sales within 18 months. If you have ever wanted to be treated as the owner of a business instead of a task worker, and you have the experience to hit a target like this, this role is built for you.



Our 18 Month Goal



- Month 6: online sales of USD 100,000 per month

- Month 12: online sales of USD 175,000 per month

- Month 18: online sales of USD 250,000 per month, a USD 3 million annual run rate

- All growth must be profitable, with advertising spend kept within agreed limits



Compensation



- Base salary of PHP 120,000 to 130,000 per month, based on experience

- Quarterly performance bonus based on growth in online gross profit

- Milestone bonuses paid when each of the month 6, 12, and 18 targets is reached

- Eligibility for a long term profit sharing arrangement after 12 months for the right person

- Paid time off and holidays

- A direct relationship with the CEO and real authority to make decisions



We currently sell one brand online and are preparing to launch our second brand along with several new products. Your mission is to lead that expansion and build our online business into a major sales channel for the company. Within your first six months, we expect our second brand and new products to be live across our online channels. By month 12, we are targeting online sales of USD 70,000 to 110,000 per month. By month 18, our committed goal is USD 125,000 per month, with a stretch goal of USD 250,000 per month, which represents a USD 3 million annual run rate. All growth must be profitable, with advertising spend kept within agreed limits, and bonuses are significantly larger for reaching the stretch goal.



Your base salary will be PHP 120,000 to 130,000 per month, based on experience, plus a 13th month payment each December. When our second brand and new products are successfully launched within your first six months, you will receive a USD 1,500 launch bonus. Starting in month 7, you will earn a quarterly bonus equal to 5 percent of the growth in our online contribution profit, which is net sales after product costs, platform fees, fulfillment, advertising, and returns. You will also earn milestone bonuses of USD 2,000 for reaching the month 12 committed goal or USD 4,000 for reaching the stretch goal, and USD 4,000 for reaching the month 18 committed goal or USD 10,000 for reaching the stretch goal. After 12 months, the right person will also become eligible for a long term profit sharing arrangement in the online business. If we reach USD 3 million together, your total earnings will place you among the best compensated ecommerce leaders in the Philippines.

How to Apply



Please send:

- Your resume

- A short summary of 2 to 3 online stores or brands you managed, including what you grew sales from and to

- A 2 to 3 minute video introducing yourself and explaining how you would approach growing a food and beverage brand to USD 3 million in online sales in 18 months

title: Track & Trace Assistant – Quality Assurance
description:
GH Logistics is a growing US-based freight brokerage and asset-based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. Our operations are built on strong systems, clear communication, accountability, and reliable execution.



We're looking for a detail-oriented Track & Trace Assistant – Quality Assurance to help prevent freight fraud, reduce operational risks, and ensure every booked load is properly verified and ready before pickup. If you have hands-on experience in US freight operations, are comfortable communicating with drivers and dispatchers, and know how to spot inconsistencies before they become bigger problems, we'd like to hear from you.



Role Overview

Every day, our company books trucks to move freight across the United States. Before those trucks pick up, our Quality Assurance team verifies that the assigned drivers are legitimate, qualified, properly documented, and prepared to execute their loads. You'll review next-day shipments, coordinate with carrier dispatch teams, verify commercial driver's licenses (CDLs), confirm tracking readiness, and conduct driver check calls to validate shipment details.



Your primary responsibility is to prevent fraud, minimize operational risks, and support on-time pickup performance. This is a hands-on operational role requiring attention to detail, proactive follow-ups, sound judgment, and the confidence to question information that doesn't add up.



What You’ll Be Doing



Load Verification & Fraud Prevention

• Ensure every booked load has its rate confirmation sent to the correct carrier.

• Contact carrier dispatch teams through phone,
, and communication channels to obtain complete driver information for next-day pickups.

• Review commercial driver's licenses (CDLs) and verify their validity through approved verification procedures.

• Identify inconsistencies in driver identities, contact details, carrier information, and load assignments.

• Immediately escalate suspicious activity or potential fraud indicators and notify Carrier Sales of carrier-related concerns.



Driver Coordination & Tracking

• Enter and maintain accurate driver information in the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Assign and confirm GPS tracking through designated tracking platforms.

• Send CDL verification links to assigned drivers and follow up on outstanding verification requirements.

• Conduct outbound check calls to confirm drivers understand pickup and delivery locations, appointment times, and required equipment.

• For team-driver loads, confirm both assigned drivers are together and heading toward pickup.

• Follow up consistently on assigned loads to ensure all required verification steps are completed before execution.



Documentation & Operational Communication

• Monitor assigned loads to confirm driver details, tracking assignments, CDL verification requests, and check calls are completed.

• Maintain clear, accurate, and timely notes in the TMS and operational dashboards.

• Coordinate with Carrier Sales, Track & Trace, and Operations to resolve missing information or discrepancies.

• Escalate unresolved issues promptly to prevent missed pickups, tracking gaps, or potential security risks.

• Follow established SOPs and maintain organized verification records for operational visibility and accountability.



What Success Looks Like

• Every assigned next-day load is reviewed before pickup.

• Rate confirmations are sent to the correct carriers.

• Driver information is complete and accurately entered into the TMS.

• Tracking is assigned and verified.

• CDL verification links are sent and required checks are followed through.

• Driver check calls are completed and documented.

• Potential fraud indicators and operational discrepancies are identified and escalated immediately.

• Sales, Operations, and Management have clear visibility into each load's verification status.



Who We’re Looking For

• At least 6 months of hands-on experience in a US freight brokerage, trucking carrier, or third-party logistics (3PL) company, preferably in dispatch, Track & Trace, carrier operations, or logistics quality assurance.

• Experience using a Transportation Management System (TMS) to review, update, and document shipment information.

• Familiarity with GPS shipment-tracking platforms.

• Comfortable making high volume outbound phone calls in English to US-based drivers and carrier dispatch teams.

• Understanding of US trucking operations, including driver assignments, pickup and delivery appointments, equipment requirements, and basic CDL verification.

• Ability to review information from multiple sources, identify discrepancies, and investigate concerns before escalating.

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple loads, prioritize urgent tasks, and follow up consistently without constant supervision.

• Strong attention to detail, accountability, and willingness to follow established SOPs.

• Minimum typing speed of 50 WPM.



Work Setup & Schedule

• Work Arrangement: Full-Time Remote | Direct Engagement with a US Company

• Schedule: Thursday – Monday, 3:00 PM – 12:00 AM Central Time

• Contract Type: Independent Contractor

• Active, attentive, and proactive Zoom participation with camera on is required throughout scheduled shifts.

• Time tracking software is used for accountability and performance monitoring.

• Reliable internet connection, back up internet & power supply, and a suitable remote workspace are required.



What You'll Get

• Long-Term Opportunity: This is an ongoing operational role, not seasonal or project-based.

• Monthly Stipend: $75 monthly insurance stipend, with eligibility beginning after 30 days of engagement.

• Regular Payment Schedule: Payments processed twice monthly according to established payroll schedules.

• Direct US Operations Exposure: Work closely with US-based logistics teams and operational leadership.

• Meaningful Operational Responsibilities: Play a direct role in preventing freight fraud, protecting shipments, and improving operational reliability.

• Structured Workflows: Established SOPs, clear expectations, and team support.



Ready to Apply?

Freight fraud is a serious risk in the logistics industry, and our Quality Assurance team plays an important role in protecting every shipment. If you enjoy investigating discrepancies, communicating with drivers, solving operational problems, and making sure things are done correctly before freight moves, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Social Media and Content Writer
description:
*** Please read through the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you can write clearly and want your work in front of aerospace, defense, and first responder professionals, read on.



Engage Video Production (EVP) is a veteran-led video production company. We make training videos, technical explainers, brand films, short documentaries, and aerial footage for aerospace, defense, and first responder clients. You will own our social media and written content so our outreach team can focus on clients.



This is a part-time role, 20 hours per week, working directly with the Creative Director and the EVP Team. Our audience is engineers, training directors, and marketing leads at technical companies and first responder organizations. They want clear, accurate, useful content. They do not want hype.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will plan, write, design, and schedule content across our channels: LinkedIn,
, YouTube, Substack, and our website blog. A lot of the work is turning our videos, projects, and the Creative Director’s ideas into posts people want to read. You will also coordinate with our business operations coordinator so content and outreach support each other.



*** Schedule ***



Currently, you must be available from 0800 to 1000 PHT each workday for to get direction, team syncs, and troubleshooting. The rest of your hours are flexible as long as deadlines are met.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Content Planning: Build and keep a monthly content calendar for every channel.



Social Posts: Write and schedule posts for 
 and
, plus titles, descriptions, and community posts for YouTube.



Long-Form Writing: Draft blog articles and Substack posts from outlines, interviews, and project notes.



Basic Graphics: Make clean post graphics and thumbnails in Canva or similar, using our brand guidelines.



Repurposing: Turn one video or project into several posts across channels.



Community: Watch comments and messages on our pages, reply where appropriate, and flag anything important.



Reporting: Send a short monthly summary of what was posted and how it performed.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Writing: Excellent written English. You can write a tight LinkedIn post and a well-structured 800-word article.



Experience: At least one year managing business social media pages, ideally including LinkedIn.



Tools: Canva or similar, and experience with at least one scheduling tool.



Accuracy: You check facts, spelling, and links before anything goes live. Technical content has to be right.



Autonomy: You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



B2B, technical, or industrial content experience

Basic short-form video editing (CapCut, Premiere, or similar) for Shorts and reels

Basic SEO for blog posts

Substack or
 newsletter experience

Familiarity with GoHighLevel

Interest in aerospace, defense, first responder, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $6.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.



Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $480 USD per month (about 19,500 to 29,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the “How to Apply” section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



Set your subject line to: “Social Media Guru - [Your Name]”

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide links to 2 or 3 business social media pages you have managed, plus one long-form piece you wrote (blog, article, or newsletter) - DO NOT GIVE ME AI examples, I want to see your actual writing. Show me your best work - No samples means no consideration. 

- State the 10th word of our “Three Pillars” section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe a specific time you posted something with a mistake in it and how you fixed it. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.



Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace, defense, and first responder work. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.

Written English – Excellent written communication skills, grammar, and ability to create natural, engaging marketing copy. Organization – Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize deadlines, and maintain accuracy. What Makes You an Excellent Fit

Understands what makes a Reel or TikTok perform well, rather than simply editing videos. Takes initiative and offers suggestions without waiting to be asked. Is resourceful, solutions-oriented, and comfortable learning new tools. Can work independently with minimal supervision while communicating regularly. Is extremely organized, dependable, and able to meet deadlines. Can manage several responsibilities without sacrificing quality. Is receptive to feedback and continuously strives to improve. A diverse role combining creative marketing, e-commerce, and business operations. Opportunities to develop new skills and take on additional responsibilities. title: YouTube Video Editor (Long-Term)
description:
Hey, I'm Giovanni! 



I'm looking for a long-form video editor to team up with me and grow my YouTube channel, TechGio. This is the most important hire I'm making for the channel. If you love clean, premium tech content and you're excited about AI, keep reading. I think you're going to like this one!



ABOUT THE CHANNEL



I work in tech sales, and TechGio started as me documenting my own path into the industry and helping others break in with no experience. That's still part of it, but the channel is expanding into something bigger: the AI and tech industry, the tools I actually use every day (Grok Bot, Claude, AI agents, and whatever comes next), and the behind-the-scenes of building my own AI startup while working full-time.



So the mix is: talking-head, screen recordings of real tools and workflows, and founder journey content. All long-form, all YouTube.



THE STYLE I'M GOING FOR



The best tech channels right now share a format: clean talking-head plus screen recordings that are actually easy to follow. Cursor highlights, smooth zooms, crisp on-screen text, diagrams that make technical ideas simple. Premium and calm, not flashy.



Channels that nail it:

• Chris Raroque (closest to the exact style I want)

• Nate Herk | AI Automation

• Alex Finn

• Brock Mesarich | AI for Non Techies



Three videos that show the exact look:


/watch?v=UyMJBUCyDIs


/watch?v=jwogmXNt7o4


/watch?v=IsUpatC9obI



You can also check my channel to see how previous videos were edited: 



If you watch these and think "I can edit at that level," you're who I'm looking for. Please watch a few before you apply!



WHAT YOU'LL DO



I batch-film, so you'll get raw talking-head footage, screen recordings, and a short brief per video (hook, structure, key moments). From there, you own the edit:

• Trim and pace. Cut dead air and bad takes, keep the energy up. Retention is the job.

• On-screen text. Captions, callouts, key numbers, lists. Sharp and well-timed.

• Screen recordings. Zooms, cursor highlights, clean cuts between me and the screen.

• Simple motion graphics. Diagrams for AI concepts, tool highlights, transitions.

• Music, sound design, color, and final export.

• Revisions from my timestamped notes. Usually one round.



Deliverables: finished video plus organized project files.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



• Experienced with long-form YouTube. You've edited talking-head + screen recording content before and can show me published videos. Please don't apply if your portfolio is mostly Shorts, gaming, or events. Nothing against that work, it's just a different job.

• Passionate about AI and tech. You follow the space, or genuinely want to. It shows in the edit when the editor gets the content.

• You use AI in your workflow. Descript, auto-captions, AI features in Premiere or Resolve, whatever makes you faster and better. My whole operation runs on AI.

• Strong with text and motion. Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve plus After Effects (or equivalent).

• Fast and reliable. First cut within 48 hours of getting footage. 24 hours is the goal. If something is going to slip, I hear about it before it does.

• Willing to adapt and learn. The tech space moves fast and the channel will evolve with it. I want someone who grows with me, takes feedback well, and cares whether the video performs.

• Clear communicator. Fluent written English, responsive on Slack or WhatsApp, comfortable working async.



PAY AND WHAT YOU GET



$50–$100 per video depending on experience and quality. We start at 2 videos a week and grow from there.



This is a long-term partnership, not a one-off gig:

• Consistent volume that grows with the channel.

• Rate increases tied to quality and consistency. Good work gets rewarded!

• Tools covered. I'm open to paying for software, plugins, or assets you need.

• First look at everything that comes next: startup launch content, product videos, and more.

• A real seat at the table. I want your ideas on hooks, pacing, and style.



QUICK FACTS



• Paid per video: $50–$100

• 2 videos a week to start

• First cut within 48 hours (24-hour goal)

• Long-form YouTube only. No Shorts.

• Slack or WhatsApp for communication



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word "GROK" so I know you read the whole thing.



Then send me:

1. 3 links to long-form YouTube videos you edited (talking-head + screen recording preferred) and exactly what you did on each.

2. Which of the reference videos above is closest to your style, and one or two sentences on why.

3. Your tools, including which AI tools you use.

4. How many 10–15 minute videos per week you can realistically deliver, and your typical first-cut turnaround.

5. Your rate per video.



The strongest applicants get a paid test edit before we commit to anything, so you get paid either way.



I need portfolio links to consider you, so please don't skip those. Excited to see your work!

title: Senior TikTok Shop Specialist – 2+ Years Proven Experience | Full-Time Remote
description:
Hiring: TikTok Shop Specialist – 2+ Years of Real Experience (Full-Time, Remote)



We run an established US-based e-commerce business selling on TikTok Shop, Amazon, Temu, and other marketplaces.



I'm looking for one experienced TikTok Shop specialist to take ownership of our TikTok Shop operations.



This is NOT an entry-level position. You must have at least 2 years of real, hands-on TikTok Shop Seller Center experience, preferably managing US-based stores.



I don't need someone who just follows instructions. I need someone who knows TikTok Shop inside and out, understands how to grow sales, solves problems independently, and gets things done.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. Product Listings & Optimization



Create and optimize TikTok Shop product listings.



Write high-converting titles, descriptions, and keywords.



Manage product images, variations, categories, and attributes.



Identify and fix listing errors, violations, and suppressed products.



Improve existing listings to increase traffic and conversions.



2. TikTok Shop Operations



Manage TikTok Shop Seller Center daily.



Monitor account health, violations, and performance metrics.



Handle product approvals, appeals, and support tickets.



Troubleshoot fulfillment, inventory, shipping, and order issues.



Stay current with TikTok Shop policies and platform changes.



3. Affiliate & Creator Management



Find and recruit relevant TikTok creators.



Manage affiliate collaborations, samples, and commissions.



Follow up with creators to get videos published.



Identify creators generating actual sales, not just views.



Build long-term creator relationships and scale successful partnerships.



4. Promotions, Campaigns & Growth



Set up and manage TikTok Shop promotions, coupons, and campaigns.



Understand TikTok Shop's affiliate and organic traffic systems.



Identify opportunities to increase GMV and profitability.



Analyze competitors, pricing, and trending products.



Track performance and recommend actions based on actual numbers.



5. TikTok Shop Ads (GMV Max)



Have hands-on experience with TikTok Shop advertising and GMV Max.



Understand budgets, ROAS, ad performance, and optimization.



Know when to scale campaigns and when to stop wasting money.



Work with our team to improve product and creative performance.



REQUIREMENTS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



Minimum 2 years of actual TikTok Shop experience.



Must have personally managed TikTok Shop Seller Center, preferably for US sellers.



Strong knowledge of listings, affiliates, promotions, violations, and account health.



Practical experience with TikTok Shop GMV Max advertising.



Comfortable working with Excel and analyzing sales data.



Strong written English.



Independent problem-solver who follows through until issues are resolved.



Available full-time, 40 hours per week.



At least 3 hours overlapping 9 AM–12 PM New York time.



Do not apply if:



You are a general VA who recently learned TikTok Shop.



Your experience is only posting TikTok videos or managing social media.



You have only taken TikTok Shop courses without managing real stores.



You are an agency.



You are looking for part-time work.



PAY & BENEFITS



Competitive monthly salary based on proven experience.



Paid monthly via Wise.



13th month pay.



Performance bonuses based on measurable results.



Salary review after 90 days.



Long-term, stable position with growth opportunities.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application subject with the word TIKTOKPRO, or I won't review it.



Answer the following questions yourself, without AI-generated responses.



Your experience: How many years have you personally managed TikTok Shop? Which countries' marketplaces have you worked with?



Proof: Share examples of TikTok Shops you managed. What exactly were you responsible for? Include real results such as monthly GMV, orders, or affiliate sales. Screenshots with sensitive information hidden are welcome.



Affiliate experience: Explain how you recruit creators, get them to post, and turn those relationships into consistent sales. Give a real example.



GMV Max: Tell me about a GMV Max campaign you personally managed. What was the budget, target ROI, actual performance, and what changes did you make?



Account problems: Tell me about a real TikTok Shop violation, product rejection, or account issue you resolved. What happened, and how did you fix it?



Scenario: We have a product selling 20 units per day on TikTok Shop. Sales suddenly drop to 3 units per day. Walk me through exactly what you would check and in what order.



Growth: You take over a TikTok Shop doing $50,000 per month in sales. What are the first five things you would audit before trying to grow it?



Availability: What is your expected monthly salary in USD? What hours can you work in New York time? Do you currently have other jobs or clients?

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description:
About us



Omni Haus is a US marketing agency that books jobs for home service contractors, starting with epoxy and garage floor coating companies. We run their ads, follow up with every homeowner, and put booked estimates on their calendar. We’re growing fast and need a sharp, confident caller to book sales calls with business owners for our founder.



What you’ll do



- Make 50+ outbound calls per hour to US business owners (garage floor and epoxy contractors) during two daily calling blocks

- Follow our proven script and framework: find the problem, offer the solution, book the call

- Handle common objections calmly and book qualified owners onto our founder’s calendar

- Build call lists each day: scrape Google Maps with a Chrome extension, clean the list with our tool, and import it into our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- Log the outcome of every call in GoHighLevel. The pipeline updates itself.

- Send a short end-of-day report: dials, owners reached, booking attempts, calls booked



Schedule



- About 3 to 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday

- Calling blocks are set to US business hours: roughly 8:00–9:30 AM and 4:00–6:00 PM US Eastern/Central time. That’s an evening and late-night shift in the Philippines.

- List building can be done at flexible times, and we will make them for you to start



Pay



Base: $400 USD per month

Bonus: $20 per booked call that shows up plus 6% commission when a client you booked signs on

Top performers can move to full time



You’re a great fit if you



- Speak excellent, natural English with a clear accent that’s easy for Americans to understand

- Have at least 6 months of US cold calling, appointment setting or SDR experience (B2B is a big plus)

- Stay calm and friendly when people say no, because most will

- Are coachable and follow a script without sounding robotic

- Show up on time, every shift. Reliability matters more than anything else here.

- Bonus: GoHighLevel experience, or experience selling to contractors or home service businesses



Requirements



- Reliable computer and stable internet

- Noise-cancelling headset and a quiet place to work

- Backup power or internet in case of outages



How to apply



To show you read the whole post, start your Loom video with the words “Garage Floors.” Applications without it won’t be reviewed.



- A short Loom video intro: your cold calling experience, what you sold, and to whom

- At the end of the Loom video, read this opener out loud as if you were on a real call: “Hey Mike, it’s [your name]. Quick question for you: can you guys take on another 4 or 5 garage floors this month, or are you pretty booked out?”

- Your expected base pay



We’ll invite the best applicants to a short live role-play call.

title: Dental Sourcer
description:
Position Overview

RSMC Services is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Offshore Sourcer to support the recruitment of dental professionals for clients across the US. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and pre-qualifying top talent, ensuring a continuous pipeline of high-quality candidates. The ideal candidate has experience in high-volume candidate sourcing, Boolean search techniques, and leveraging multiple recruitment platforms. This position requires strong research skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently in a remote, fast-paced environment while closely collaborating with recruiters and hiring managers.



Job Description

• Utilize various sourcing techniques, including Boolean search, job boards, and social media platforms, to identify potential candidates.

• Conduct market research to map talent pools and stay updated on industry trends.

• Build and maintain a pipeline of pre-qualified candidates for current and future hiring needs.

• Engage passive candidates through effective outreach strategies.

• Screen candidate profiles and assess initial qualifications before passing them to recruiters.

• Collaborate with recruiters and hiring managers to understand job requirements and sourcing priorities.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate data in the applicant tracking system (ATS).

• Track and report sourcing metrics to optimize recruitment strategies.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for Onshore Recruiter Manager

1. Candidate Sourcing & Pipeline Development

o Source qualified dental professionals (Dentists, Hygienists, Assistants, Front Office Staff) to the pipeline per month.

o Ensure that sourced candidates meet job requirements (licenses, experience, location, availability).

o Maintain an active database of pre-screened candidates to support ongoing hiring needs.

2. Speed & Efficiency

o Identify and submit qualified candidates per week to offshore recruiters for screening.

o Reduce time-to-source candidates using Boolean searches, LinkedIn, job boards, and referral networks.

o Ensure a response time of under 24 hours when engaging with potential candidates.

3. Data Accuracy & ATS Management

o Maintain 100% accuracy in candidate data entry in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

o Update candidate profiles with correct contact information, credentials, and availability before submission.

o Ensure zero duplicate or unqualified candidate submissions, improving recruiter efficiency.

4. Communication & Collaboration

o Ensure daily coordination with offshore recruiters to prioritize sourcing needs.

o Maintain candidate outreach response, improving engagement and conversion.

5. Market Intelligence & Process Improvement

o Identify new sourcing channels or strategies per quarter to enhance talent acquisition.

o Track and report weekly sourcing performance metrics to optimize search strategies.

o Stay updated on state dental industry hiring trends to refine sourcing strategies.



Qualifications

• Experience: 1-2+ years of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment, preferably in healthcare, dental, or high-volume staffing.

• Candidate Sourcing Expertise: Ability to identify and attract passive and active candidates using Boolean searches, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, and referral networks.

• Database & Pipeline Management: Experience in building and maintaining an organized talent pipeline to support ongoing recruitment needs.

• Technology Proficiency: Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing tools.

• Speed & Efficiency: Strong ability to source and submit 50-100 qualified candidates per week, meeting hiring demands.

• Communication & Candidate Engagement: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills to conduct initial outreach and pre-screening.

• Data Accuracy & ATS Management: Ability to maintain 100% accuracy in candidate records, ensuring all relevant details are updated.

• Collaboration & Teamwork: Ability to work effectively with offshore recruiters and onshore hiring teams to prioritize sourcing needs.

title: Digital Marketing & Paid Creative Specialist
description:
About Leadlnk



Leadlnk is a performance marketing company specialising in generating high-quality leads through paid digital advertising.



We're growing quickly and are looking for a Digital Marketing & Paid Creative Specialist to join our team full-time.



This is a hands-on role focused heavily on creating and editing high-performing video advertising for Meta and TikTok.



You'll take raw footage, concepts and creative ideas and turn them into engaging paid advertisements designed to stop people scrolling, generate interest and ultimately drive leads.



Alongside creative production, you'll support the team with marketing administration, campaign statistics and performance reporting.



The Role



Your main responsibility will be producing and improving video creatives for paid advertising campaigns across Meta and TikTok.



You'll work closely with our media buying team to understand what's performing, identify opportunities for new creative and continually produce new variations to improve campaign performance.



This isn't an organic social media role.



The content you create has a commercial purpose — generating leads and improving advertising performance.



You'll also assist with reporting, statistics, marketing administration and other projects across the business.



What You'll Be Doing



🎥 Paid Ad Creative — Meta & TikTok



Edit short-form video advertisements for Meta and TikTok



Turn raw footage into attention-grabbing paid advertising creatives



Create multiple variations of winning concepts



Produce different hooks, openings, messaging and calls-to-action



Add captions, graphics, transitions, sound effects and other elements



Adapt creatives for different audiences and campaigns



Repurpose existing footage into new advertising concepts



Work closely with media buyers to understand campaign performance



Use performance data to influence future creative decisions



Continuously test new creative angles and formats



Keep up with current Meta and TikTok creative trends



Help build a structured library of high-performing creative



📈 Performance Creative



You'll learn to think beyond simply making a video look good.



You'll need to understand:



What makes someone stop scrolling



How to create strong hooks



How to communicate an offer quickly



How creative affects CTR, CPL and lead volume



Why certain concepts outperform others



How to iterate based on actual campaign data



The goal isn't simply "make a good video."



The goal is "make a video that performs."



📊 Statistics & Reporting



Track creative and campaign performance



Monitor key advertising metrics



Help identify which creative concepts are performing best



Produce regular performance reports



Maintain accurate spreadsheets and marketing data



Spot trends and opportunities from campaign results



Feed performance insights back into the creative process



🗂️ Marketing Administration



Keep creative files and assets organised



Maintain creative testing libraries



Help manage content and production schedules



Assist with campaign and marketing projects



Support the wider team with administrative tasks



Help keep internal marketing systems and documents up to date



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is creative, commercially minded, organised and obsessed with improving their work.



Ideally, you'll have:



Experience editing short-form video



Experience creating video specifically for paid advertising



Strong understanding of TikTok and Meta creative formats



Experience using CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or similar



A strong understanding of hooks, pacing and attention retention



Good visual judgement and attention to detail



An interest in performance marketing and advertising



Comfortable working with spreadsheets and performance data



Strong written and spoken English



Excellent organisation and time management



Ability to work independently in a remote environment



A proactive attitude and willingness to test new ideas



Experience With Any of These Is a Bonus



Meta Ads



TikTok Ads



Direct-response advertising



Lead generation



UGC advertising



Performance creative



Copywriting for advertisements



AI video/image generation tools



Google Analytics or other analytics platforms



What We Offer



Full-time remote position



Work with a growing UK-based performance marketing company



Competitive salary



Performance-based incentives



Long-term opportunity to grow with the business



Training and development



Exposure to paid advertising, creative strategy and lead generation



Work directly with experienced media buyers and marketing specialists



Opportunity to take ownership of the creative function as the company grows



International remote working environment



Who We're Looking For



This role is ideal for someone who wants to understand why advertising works, not just how to edit a video.



You could be taking a winning ad, creating five new variations, reviewing the performance data and then using those insights to develop the next batch of creatives.



We're looking for someone who can combine creativity + speed + attention to detail + commercial thinking.



If you're excited by the idea of seeing your work directly influence advertising performance and lead generation, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply Now



Send us your CV and examples of your previous video or advertising work.



If you have created paid advertising creatives before, we'd particularly like to see them.

title: Part-Time Cold Caller- U.S. Commercial Asphalt Company
description:
We are an Atlanta, Georgia-based asphalt maintenance company specializing in sealcoating, crack repair, parking lot striping, pothole repair, and asphalt maintenance.



We serve commercial properties, including shopping centers, warehouses, schools, hospitals, and HOA communities.



We are looking for a reliable, confident, and results-driven cold caller to help us connect with property managers and other decision-makers who need parking lot maintenance services.



## Responsibilities



* Make outbound calls to commercial property managers, facility managers, HOA management companies, and property owners using provided lead lists.

* Identify and reach the person responsible for parking lot maintenance and repairs.

* Qualify potential customers and schedule appointments for free estimates.

* Record all calls, contact information, and results accurately in Google Sheets.

* Send brief follow-up
s when needed.

* During slower periods, research and find contact information for property managers and potential clients.

* Follow up with qualified leads to help generate new business opportunities.



**Your main goal is to book qualified appointments that can lead to signed contracts.** You will not be responsible for preparing estimates or completing sales contracts.



## Working Schedule



**U.S. Eastern Time:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–11:30 AM



**Philippine Time:**

* Before November 1, 2026: 8:30 PM–11:30 PM

* Starting November 1, 2026: 9:30 PM–12:30 AM



You must be available to work consistently during these hours.



## Compensation



* **Base pay:** $5 per hour.

* **Appointment bonus:** $10 for each qualified appointment (decision-maker confirmed, commercial property, agrees to a free estimate).

* **Closed-deal bonus:** $25–$50 for each appointment that results in a signed contract within 6 months, depending on project value.

* Payments are made every two weeks via Wise or PayPal.

* A paid two-week trial period will be provided.



High-performing candidates may have the opportunity to transition to a full-time position next year.



## Requirements



* At least one year of outbound cold-calling experience with U.S. businesses; BPO experience is strongly preferred.

* Fluent spoken English with clear pronunciation and a confident, professional phone manner.

* Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection.

* A quiet home office and a quality headset.

* Strong organizational skills and consistent call tracking.

* Self-motivated, dependable, and able to work independently.



## Tools Provided



* Vumber or a similar calling application.

* Google Sheets for lead tracking.

* Gmail for follow-up
s.



## How to Apply



Please send your application with the following information:



**1. Start your message with:** Atlanta Asphalt



**2. A 60-second voice recording:** Introduce yourself as if you were calling a U.S. property manager about commercial asphalt maintenance services. We want to hear your spoken English, confidence, and phone communication skills.



**3. Your cold-calling experience:** Tell us which industries you have called, your typical number of calls per day, and how many qualified appointments you usually book.



**4. Schedule confirmation:** Confirm that you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–11:30 AM U.S. Eastern Time.



**Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.**



We are looking for someone reliable who wants to build a long-term working relationship and help grow our business.

title: Ecommerce Bookkeeper for US Supplement Brand (Shopify, Stripe, PayPal, Amazon)
description:
We are a US company running a 7-figure online supplement brand. Most of our revenue comes from subscriptions with recurring billing.



We are looking for a bookkeeper who keeps our books clean and closes every month on time. This is ongoing, long-term work.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Categorize and reconcile every transaction, every month

- Sources: Shopify, CheckoutChamp, Stripe, PayPal, Amazon Seller Central and a US business bank account

- Reconcile payment processor payouts, including fees, refunds, chargebacks and reserves

- Match supplier invoices and contractor payments

- Check warehouse (3PL) invoices against our order data before we pay them

- Track cost of goods, fulfillment costs, processing fees, refunds and chargebacks

- Close the month in QuickBooks Online or Xero within 10 days

- Fill a fixed monthly report that we provide



This role does not include tax filing. We already have an accountant for taxes.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Real experience doing the books for an online store that sells physical products

- Experience with subscriptions or recurring billing

- You have reconciled Stripe and PayPal payouts yourself, many times

- You understand inventory and landed cost

- You check numbers before you trust them, and you ask when something is unclear

- Good written English



If you have only done bookkeeping for service businesses or local shops, this job is not a good fit.



HOW TO APPLY



Do not send us a message here. We do not read applications sent through OnlineJobs.



The only way to apply is to take our skills test at this link:







About the test:

- It takes up to 25 minutes

- It uses real bookkeeping calculations from a month like ours

- Use a computer, not a phone

- The test is monitored by an automatic security check

- You tell us your rate at the end of the test



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. Skills test at the link above

2. The best results get a second, practical test

3. Short video call

4. Paid trial on one month of real data



We only contact candidates who pass the test.
